多智能体系统

[MA-0] Strategic Tanking in Stable Matching Markets

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在稳定匹配（stable matching）框架下，个体如何通过非直接的偏好操纵手段实现自身匹配结果优化的问题。传统研究中，代理人通常通过虚假报告偏好顺序来操纵匹配结果，而本文提出“战略性削弱”（strategic tanking）这一新机制：即代理人主动降低自己对某些潜在匹配对象的吸引力，从而影响对方对自己的排序，进而在不改变自身真实偏好的前提下实现更优匹配。其解决方案的关键在于揭示了“截断式削弱”（cutoff tanking）与经典偏好截断（truncation）在稳定匹配结果上的等价性——即当代理人对低于某一阈值的所有潜在伙伴进行削弱时，其效果等同于在自身偏好列表中截断该阈值以下的选项。然而，任意削弱（arbitrary tanking）则具有更强的策略灵活性，在提议者延迟接受（proposer-deferred acceptance）机制下，均衡匹配可能超出诚实匹配的稳定集（sincere stable set）。因此，即使一方被强制诚实报告偏好，只要真诚稳定集包含多个匹配结果，仍可通过传统偏好操纵或削弱行为获得收益，表明战略削弱是比传统操纵更具扩展性的有效策略工具。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.42105
作者: James P. Bailey
机构: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (伦斯勒理工学院)
类目: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Motivated by a broad literature in psychology, organizational behavior, and matching markets, we introduce strategic tanking: an agent deliberately makes themselves less attractive to selected potential partners in order to improve their eventual assignment. Unlike traditional manipulation in stable matching, a tanker does not misreport whom they prefer; instead, they influence how others rank them. We show that tanking has a striking connection to classical preference manipulation. Cutoff tanking, in which an agent tanks with every potential partner below a chosen threshold, has exactly the same effect on the stable set as truncating one’s own preference list at that threshold. Thus an agent can reproduce the power of a classical truncation while leaving their own preferences unchanged and every match acceptable. Arbitrary tanking, however, can go substantially further: under proposer-deferred acceptance, tanking equilibria can lie outside the sincere stable set. More broadly, whenever the sincere stable set contains multiple matchings, profitable strategic behavior remains available through either traditional preference manipulation or tanking, even when one side is restricted to honestly reporting their own preferences.

[MA-1] Adaptive Coverag e Algorithms for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks in Dynamic Worlds

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在未知环境中进行通信网络覆盖时面临的动态不稳定性问题。传统问题——部分可观测协作守卫艺术馆问题（Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Gallery Problem, POCGAGP）——假设环境静态且已知，但无法应对实际部署中常见的不确定性。为此，本文提出动态情形下的扩展版本（DPOCGAGP），引入“智能体丢失”（Agent Loss）与“世界变化”（World Change）两类动态扰动，以模拟真实场景中的不可预测性。解决方案的关键在于对两种先进算法——集中式智能体引导探索网络覆盖（CADENCE）及其去中心化变体（DADENCE）——进行改进，使其具备在动态环境下维持网络连通性和覆盖完整性的能力。实验结果表明，在包含超过4500个不同规模与结构测试案例的基准集上，改进后的算法性能显著优于现有最优基准算法，验证了其在动态复杂环境中的鲁棒性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41936
作者: Hugo Gandhi,Edwin Meriaux,Antonio Loría
机构: CentraleSupélec(中央理工-高等电力学院); CNRS(法国国家科学研究中心)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper extends an existing framework for the coordination of mobile agents in unknown worlds, by considering the possibility of dynamic instability. In the original problem, known as the Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Gallery Problem (POCGAGP) (arXiv:2512.09495), the multi-agent system must establish a communication network which completely covers an initially unknown constrained space. However, the POCGAGP fails to account for the unpredictability often seen in real-world deployment. To address this, the dynamic case (DPOCGAGP) introduces two settings which can influence the mobile network during deployment: Agent Loss and World Change, which represent dynamic changes to the world. Within this study, we present advancements to two state-of-the-art algorithms, the Centralized Agent-Directed Exploration for Network Coverage (CADENCE), and its decentralized analogue, DADENCE, to provide solutions in these cases. We then compare their performance against another state-of-the-art benchmark algorithm, and show that the adapted algorithms outperform across our benchmark test set, which comprises over 4500 test cases of varied size and structure.

[MA-2] AI evaluators favor job applications written by certain AI models independent of candidate quality

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在全自动化招聘场景中，生成式 AI（Generative AI）模型的选择是否会在不考虑候选人实际资质的情况下影响录用结果这一关键问题。其核心解决方案在于构建了一个多模型审计框架，将11个由不同大语言模型（LLM）驱动的求职信撰写代理与9个通过API托管的评估代理相结合，针对10份职位描述和每份职位50名候选人进行系统性测试。研究发现，撰写模型存在显著的“生成偏好层级”：无论模型许可证类型如何，本地部署模型均系统性处于劣势，且评估模型普遍存在“自我偏好偏差”，倾向于优先录用自身生成的内容。此外，评估模型在对工具选择引入的偏差程度上表现出显著差异，为设计更公平的筛选机制提供了可操作指导。该偏好层级带来了可量化的竞争后果——在最不利的模型匹配组合下，约有1.8名合格候选人因模型适配不当而被错误过滤。进一步分析表明，上述现象可归因于一个共同机制：撰写模型对特定风格特征的依赖程度与评估模型对该类特征的奖惩强度之间存在高度关联，而一旦控制这些显性特征，便无显著证据表明存在未测量的“撰写者指纹”。研究揭示了生成式 AI 在招聘中的算法公平性风险，并强调需建立可随模型生态演进而复用的审计框架，以应对AI辅助筛选的监管挑战。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41866
作者: Nicolò Pagan,Michael Andreas Ebling,Stefania Ionescu,Anikó Hannák
机构: Universität Zürich(苏黎世大学); ETH Zürich(苏黎世联邦理工学院)
类目: Computers and Society (cs.CY); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Job applicants increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to write cover letters, while employers deploy LLMs to screen them. In this all-AI setting, we ask whether the \emphchoice of model affects hiring outcomes independently of candidate qualifications. We introduce a multi-model auditing framework pairing eleven LLM writer agents with nine API-hosted evaluator agents across ten job descriptions and fifty candidates per job. Four findings emerge. First, we identify a generative preference hierarchy: a consistent global ranking of writer models by evaluator acceptance, in which locally hosted models are systematically disadvantaged regardless of their license, compounded by self-preference bias where evaluators favour their own outputs. Second, evaluator models differ substantially in how much bias they introduce based on applicants’ tool choice, offering actionable guidance for fairer screening design. Third, this hierarchy has measurable competitive consequences: in the most adverse pairing, approximately two (1.8) out of twenty-five qualified candidates are filtered out purely due to model mismatch. Fourth, a common mechanism explains the patterns above: writer preference and self-preference trace to a combination of how much each writer leans on specific stylistic cues and how strongly evaluators, often unanimously, reward or penalise those same cues. A further check finds little evidence that an unmeasured “writer fingerprint” remains once these same features are accounted for. We discuss implications for algorithmic fairness in employment, regulation of AI-assisted screening, and the design of auditing frameworks that can be reapplied as the model landscape evolves.

[MA-3] ORION: An Outcome-Driven LLM Advisor for RL-Based Multi-Domain 6G Slice Placement

【速读】：该论文旨在解决6G网络切片在跨管理域部署中面临的在线决策难题，即针对每个到达的请求，需协同决定虚拟网络功能（VNF）的归属域、流量跨域传输路径以及切片是否被接纳。该联合决策问题在连续请求场景下属于NP-hard问题。实验表明，不存在一种固定的规划策略能在所有拓扑环境下保持最优性能，不同拓扑类别间性能排名会发生反转，且多数被拒绝请求实际上存在可行部署方案但未被发现，这揭示了“规划层”是影响系统性能的关键杠杆。为此，论文提出ORION——一个分层编排架构，其中两个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体将服务意图转化为结构化请求并生成抽象部署计划；一个协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）协调器负责跨域划分，将计划作为持久的软先验；各域内智能体则执行具体功能部署。ORION的核心创新在于规划层引入了一种以结果为导向的周期性记忆机制，该机制记录每次尝试的网络状态特征、所提计划及其验证后的可行性结果，并将已验证的成功与标注失败反馈回规划器，从而基于实际部署可行性而非规划器自身提案的标量奖励实现自适应闭环优化。为隔离规划质量的影响，研究在保持下游选择与执行机制不变的前提下，在保留的拓扑族上评估规划器性能：结果表明，引入该记忆机制后，相较于无记忆的同一规划器，接纳率提升4.6%至11.5%，且基于重要性的记忆保留策略贡献了大部分性能增益，优于先进先出存储方式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41563
作者: Mahmoud S. Mayaleh,Fetia Bannour,Nour-El-Houda Yellas
机构: SAMOVAR, Télécom SudParis; Institut Polytechnique de Paris; LIX, École polytechnique
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Networking and Internet Architecture (cs.NI)
备注: Accepted at IEEE MobiWac 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deploying 6G network slices across administrative domains requires an online decision for each arriving request: which domain hosts each virtual network function, how traffic crosses domain boundaries, and whether the slice is admitted. This joint decision problem is NP-hard under continuous arrivals. Experiments on a parametrized family of multi-domain topologies show that no fixed planning strategy dominates across all regimes: the performance ranking reverses between topology classes, and feasible placements exist for most rejected requests but remain undiscovered. These findings identify the plan layer as the decisive performance lever. We introduce ORION, a hierarchical orchestrator in which two LLM agents translate service intents into structured requests and generate abstract placement plans. A cooperative multi-agent RL coordinator selects the cross-domain partition, treating the plan as a persistent soft prior, while per-domain agents place the functions. ORION main contribution lies at the plan layer: an outcome-driven episodic memory that records, for each completed attempt, the network-condition profile, the proposed plan, and its verified feasibility outcome. The memory feeds verified successes and labelled failures back to the planner, thereby closing the adaptation loop using deployment feasibility rather than a scalar reward assigned to the planner’s own proposals. To isolate the effect of the plan quality, we evaluate the planner on held-out topology families while keeping the downstream selection and execution mechanisms fixed. Under this controlled setting, the proposed memory improves admission by 4.6 – 11.5 percentage points over the same planner without memory, while importance-based retention accounts for most of the improvement over a first-in-first-out store.

[MA-4] When Disclosure Is Compulsory: Evaluating Ride-Hailing Rebalancing Policies with Self-Interested LLM Driver Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决欧盟平台工作指令（Platform Work Directive）在实施后对网约车平台动态调度机制透明化要求所带来的影响问题，特别是如何评估在强制披露自动化决策规则背景下，不同再平衡策略（rebalancing policy）对司机、平台及用户三方利益的差异化影响。其核心解决方案在于构建一个基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理的仿真框架，模拟司机在规则公开条件下以自利为目标的行为响应。关键创新点在于：将平台的自动化决策规则以可读形式输入至LLM代理中，使司机能够根据规则自主优化行为路径；通过对比反应式策略（R）与前瞻式策略（A）在规则披露前后的表现差异，揭示出即使在完全合规下绩效相近的两种策略，在规则公开后可能产生截然相反的结果——例如，反应式策略因需支付司机原本免费执行的移动成本而致平台利润下降3.7%，而前瞻式策略则保持稳定，且在曼哈顿场景下实现司机收入、平台利润与服务率的“三赢”提升。这一研究首次将生成式AI（Generative AI）引入平台治理评估，为新监管环境下政策效果的量化分析提供了可操作的评估框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41132
作者: Xinyu Wang,Andres Fielbaum
机构: The University of Sydney (悉尼大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The EU Platform Work Directive, to be transposed by December 2026, requires ride-hailing platforms to state in plain language the main parameters of their automated decisions and how a worker’s behaviour affects them. Such rules are exactly what a large language model (LLM) can read, so drivers will be able to let one decide for them. We compare two main families of rebalancing policy once their rules are public: a reactive policy ® that sends idle drivers to cover requests just lost, and an anticipatory policy (A) that plans moves on a demand forecast. Each driver is an LLM agent maximizing its own net income, given no rules (N) or the rules at the directive’s level of detail (L). We test two LLMs, Claude Haiku 5.5 and Jev, which understand the rules equally well, in a three-zone model and in Manhattan. With the rules disclosed, drivers follow the platform more closely: in Manhattan, the share of relocation offers they decline falls from about four in five to one in four under both policies. Yet the effects differ by policy. For the platform, disclosure costs R 3.7% of its profit in Manhattan, as R now pays for moves drivers used to make for free, while A’s profit is unchanged; the two policies, which tie on profit under full compliance, end 6.1% apart. For drivers, disclosure raises income in the small model under both policies and LLMs; for users, it raises the service rate there by 10 to 18 percentage points. In Manhattan, self-interested drivers also make A a win-win-win against full compliance, raising driver income, platform profit and service rate by 10 to 12% each. Rebalancing policies that perform equally well under full compliance can thus show opposite results under mandatory disclosure. The study offers a framework to evaluate such policies under the new requirement and is, to our knowledge, the first to do so with LLM agents.

[MA-5] A Robust Approach to Belief Mismatch in Non-cooperative Dynamic Games

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体控制与机器人应用中博弈论模型在动态、不完全信息场景下因理论与计算复杂性导致的不可行性问题。现有方法为降低计算复杂度，通常假设智能体共享传感器测量并维持对状态不确定性的共同估计，但这在本质上强制了非合作博弈中的协作行为，违背了实际场景的非合作特性。本文从“自车”（ego agent）视角出发，兼顾计算可处理性与对其他智能体因私有传感器测量导致状态估计偏差所引发的意外行为的鲁棒性。其核心解决方案是构建一个带有扰动贝叶斯动力学的增强信念空间（augmented belief space），使自车能够预测各智能体潜在的分歧状态估计。这些扰动由一个假想的对抗性“自然”（nature）选择，以反映其他智能体基于自车无法观测的测量所形成的估计偏离自车信念的可能性。该方法在精神上扩展了经典的H-infinity鲁棒控制思想，适用于非合作、随机动态博弈场景。文中提出的求解器具有多项式时间迭代复杂度，并通过两个实验验证：基于鲁棒信念空间推理的自车能主动限制未来对其他智能体信念与行为建模错误的脆弱性，性能退化降低超过48%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40999
作者: Ryan Park,Li-huan Shen,Jesse Milzman,Negar Mehr,David Fridovich-Keil
机构: University of California, Berkeley (加州大学伯克利分校); U.S. Army Research Laboratory (美国陆军研究实验室); University of Texas, Austin (德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Game-theoretic models are increasingly used to describe multi-agent interactions in control and robotics applications. However, theoretical and computational complexity makes these models intractable in many dynamic, incomplete information scenarios. Recent work makes strong assumptions to reduce computational complexity: agents share sensor measurements with one another and maintain a common estimate of state uncertainty. Unfortunately, these assumptions enforce a degree of cooperation in generically noncooperative interactions. This paper takes the perspective of an ego agent seeking both computational tractability and robustness to unanticipated behavior of other agents due to mismatched state estimates from private—rather than shared—sensor measurements. To that end, we formulate the game theoretic planning problem in an augmented belief space with perturbed Bayesian dynamics that allows the ego to predict all agents’ potentially divergent state estimates. These perturbations are chosen by a hypothetical adversary, ``nature,‘’ to reflect how non-ego agents’ state estimates—based on measurements the ego agent will not see at runtime—may deviate from the ego’s own belief. Ultimately, our approach can be understood in the spirit of classical H-infinity robust control, extended to noncooperative, stochastic dynamic games. We present a solver with polynomial-time iterations and conduct two experiments which show how robust belief space reasoning leads ego agents to proactively limit their future vulnerability to model misspecification of other agents’ beliefs and actions, reducing performance degradation by over 48%.

[MA-6] Renegotiable Options Fail to Prevent Hold-Up Between Two Profit-Maximizing Frontier LLM Agents

【速读】：该论文试图解决的核心问题是：在存在“敲竹杠”（hold-up）问题的交易情境中，原本能够激励人类参与者增加投资的合同条款（如可重新谈判的期权），是否同样能有效激励以利润最大化为目标的语言模型代理（language-model agents）进行投资。其关键在于检验合同机制在人类与人工智能代理之间的有效性差异——尽管在人类实验中，可重新谈判的期权显著提升了投资水平（从41.5%提升至67.2%），但在由Claude Opus 5.5和GPT-6.1 Sol等生成式AI代理进行的一次性博弈实验中，这些合同条款并未产生相同效果。研究发现，当代理被设定为追求自身利润最大化时，它们遵循了经典博弈论预测：在可重新谈判的期权下，卖方因预见到买方可能放弃期权并提出更低报价而选择不适应；而在不可重新谈判的期权下，卖方则会适应。进一步实验表明，即使移除利润指令或调整参数使适应不再带来收益，代理也不会盲目适应。因此，该研究的关键结论是：一种在人类间有效提升投资的合同机制，在以利润最大化为导向的语言模型代理之间并不具备同样的激励效力，这揭示了人类行为与理性代理在合同响应机制上的根本差异。

Abstract:Do contract terms that protect investment between people also protect it between profit-maximizing language-model agents? In the hold-up problem, a seller can adapt a unit to one buyer at a cost before the price is set. Once that cost is sunk, the buyer can offer almost nothing and the seller will still accept, so a seller who foresees this does not adapt. One remedy is an option: the buyer may buy at a fixed price. In theory the option stops working if the buyer can let it lapse and offer its own price instead. Yet in a laboratory experiment by Hoppe and Schmitz, this renegotiable option raised human investment from 41.5% of pairs without a contract to 67.2%. We had Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, each told to maximize its side’s profit, play a one-shot game with the same strategic structure under their four contract regimes and a reference-price control. The agents did what game theory predicts: under the renegotiable option no seller adapted, and under the option that rules out this renegotiation every seller did. In a second experiment in which sellers no longer stated their expected revenue before deciding, removing the profit instruction left investment unchanged under no contract and both options. When we changed the numbers so that the buyer would exercise the option even without adaptation, adapting only added cost, and no seller adapted: the agents did not simply adapt whenever an option was offered or whenever its price covered the cost. Under our protocol, a contract term that raised investment between people did not protect it between agents.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式大语言模型智能体在真实部署场景中进行测试时缩放（Test-time Scaling, TTS）所面临的挑战，即传统TTS方法依赖于并行执行多条候选轨迹的假设在共享、不可重置且存在不可逆副作用的实际环境中难以成立。其核心问题在于：如何在不重复创建或修改共享环境状态的前提下，实现对多个潜在行为轨迹的安全、高效模拟与评估。解决方案的关键是提出代理世界建模（Agentic World Modeling, AWM），将下一观测预测重构为一个多轮证据获取任务；针对每个假设动作，AWM通过安全的只读接口自适应地查询真实环境，基于返回的证据进行推理，并利用可执行计算构建结果观测，而无需改变共享状态。该方法实现了在单一共享环境上进行轨迹级并行探索，克服了传统生成式世界模型因压缩环境状态至单个提示而导致的部分可观测性下过渡模拟不可靠的问题。实验表明，在τ-bench、AppWorld和OfficeBench三个基准上，AWM相比单次仿真基线平均提升40.07%，相比训练好的世界模型基线平均提升12.36%，验证了交互式、读取驱动的模拟作为安全且可扩展的代理测试时缩放基础的可行性。

类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

Abstract:Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel. This assumption breaks in realistic deployments, where enterprise workspaces and cloud services are shared and persistent, costly or infeasible to replicate, and actions may introduce irreversible side effects or cross-trajectory interference. Existing generative world models avoid direct execution, but typically compress environment state into a single prompt, limiting their ability to reliably simulate transitions under partial observability. Instead, we introduce Agentic World Modeling (AWM), which reformulates next-observation prediction as a multi-turn evidence-acquisition task. For each hypothetical action, an agentic simulator adaptively queries the real environment through safe read-only interfaces, reasons over the returned evidence, and uses executable computation to construct the resulting observation without mutating shared state. Integrated with trajectory-level TTS, AWM enables parallel exploration over a single shared environment. Across \tau -bench, AppWorld, and OfficeBench, AWM outperforms a single-shot simulation baseline by 40.07% on average, and surpasses a trained world-model baseline by 12.36% on average. These results establish interactive, read-grounded simulation as a practical foundation for safe and scalable agentic test-time scaling in shared, non-resettable environments.

[MA-8] How a group that cannot communicate knows itself by its enemy

【速读】：该论文旨在解决团队在无法直接通信的情况下如何有效获取外部信息以提升整体决策能力的问题，尤其针对那些成员间无法交流但需共同应对一个反应性对手（adversary）的场景。其核心挑战在于：每个成员仅能观测局部信息，而对手会根据团队整体行为做出响应，这种响应本身构成一种“暗示”（tell），可被团队成员解读以获得超越个体认知的信息。解决方案的关键在于团队通过预先承诺其集体响应策略（commitment to collective response），从而将对手的隐藏行为转化为可利用的信息源。具体而言，当对手更关注自身目标而非欺骗时，团队无需依赖内部通信即可实现最优表现；而在对手有动机隐瞒信息的情境下，团队通过主动承诺不完全使用所获信息（如在高斯模型中故意放弃部分信息以换取对手的暴露成本），反而能获取真实信息并降低对手的隐藏激励。此外，信任的分配方式也至关重要——通过引入可替代的异质响应成员或微小的信任折扣机制，可避免对敌方意图误判。因此，该研究揭示了信息并非仅靠收集或聚合产生，而是由团队如何承诺其对外反应方式所“生成”的。

机构: Cornell University (康奈尔大学)
类目: Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Robotics (cs.RO); Systems and Control (eess.SY)
备注: 6 pages main text; 35-page SI Appendix included as an ancillary file. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Teams that cannot communicate seem stuck with what each member sees. We show that their opponent can tell them the rest. Silent hunters, jammed robots and traders who never meet all face an adversary that reacts to the group as a whole; every member can read that reaction, a tell, and learn what no member knows alone. One tell can do the work of a message from every member. The adversary would rather hide, but hiding interferes with its own task, and a team that commits in advance to how it will respond decides how much hiding is worth. A committed team never loses when its opponent cares more about its own goals, and does as well as a fully informed team exactly when the opponent’s stake outweighs any gain from lying. Below that point the team learns more by trusting less: in a solved Gaussian model it obtains the truth by promising not to use all of it and keeps the cost the opponent would have paid to conceal; an exact test decides when this holds in finite games. How a team spreads its trust matters too. A lone uninformed member with a full-support prior needs a private coin, but with additive squared-error losses two interchangeable members who respond differently replace it, and a small discount on trust insures against misjudging the enemy. Information, on this view, is not only gathered or aggregated; it is produced by how a team commits to respond.

[MA-9] Distributed Grid Search for Hyperparameter Tuning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决分布式优化算法在对等网络中性能高度依赖超参数选择，而现有超参数选取方法通常需要全局信息、保守性较强或与特定算法及超参数绑定的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于共识的分布式网格搜索方法——分布式网格搜索（Distributed Grid Search, D-GS），该方法仅需各节点运行待调优算法并计算局部梯度即可在全网范围内评估和选择最优超参数配置。为进一步提升效率，论文还提出了改进版本——分布式聚焦网格搜索（Distributed Zoom Grid Search, D-ZGS），通过自适应缩小搜索空间，在降低计算成本的同时显著提升实际性能。理论分析证明，两种方法均能在有限时间内使所有节点达成一致的超参数配置，并量化了该配置的（次）最优性。数值实验表明，D-GS在线性回归与逻辑回归任务中性能接近集中式基准，且调参与部署成本仅为传统基于理论推导方法的极小部分。

Abstract:The performance of many distributed optimization algorithms over peer-to-peer networks strongly depends on the choice of their hyperparameters. However, existing selection rules often require global quantities, yield conservative choices, or are tied to specific algorithms and hyperparameters. We propose Distributed Grid Search (D-GS), a consensus-based search method that evaluates and selects hyperparameter configurations across the network, requiring only the ability to run the tuned algorithm and evaluate local gradients. We also propose a zoom-in variant, Distributed Zoom Grid Search (D-ZGS), which improves empirical performance at a reduced cost. We prove that both methods terminate in finite time with all agents holding the same hyperparameter configuration, and quantify the (sub)optimality of this configuration. Numerical experiments on linear and logistic regression show that D-GS closely matches a centralized reference and that tuning and deployment cost a fraction of deploying algorithms with hyperparameters tuned using theoretical results.

[MA-10] Understanding LLM -Based Bargaining of Driving Agents in Mixed-Autonomy Traffic

【速读】：该论文旨在解决混合自主交通环境中，基于生成式 AI (Generative AI) 的自动驾驶汽车（AV）与人类驾驶车辆（HV）在共享道路空间时的群体层面协商行为建模问题。其核心挑战在于理解异构代理间复杂的社会互动机制，尤其是在不同交通密度、代理目标及交通领域知识条件下，协商结果的多样性与动态演化规律。解决方案的关键在于提出一种行为分类体系（behavioral taxonomy），通过联合分析数值竞价行为与沟通态度，系统刻画交互过程中的双重社会性维度：一是代理间的博弈动态，二是个体私有意图向公共表达的转化机制。研究发现，达成协议的场景中表现出更强的建设性互惠性，而协商失败场景则伴随更频繁的冲突升级；同时，即使数值报价保持不变，私人与公开沟通态度之间仍存在显著差异。这一框架为深入解析生成式 AI 驱动的混合交通系统中的社会交互行为提供了结构化分析工具。

类目: Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a flexible computational approach for modeling social interactions among heterogeneous agents. This paper develops a novel framework towards characterizing and understanding LLM-based population-level bargaining of shared road space between autonomous vehicle (AV) and human-driven vehicle (HV) agents in mixed-autonomy traffic. Through controlled experiments varying traffic density, agent objectives, and traffic-domain knowledge, we first characterize bargaining outcomes and observe heterogeneous agreement rates across different experimental conditions. To understand how the bargaining process shapes the outcomes, we introduce a behavioral taxonomy that jointly characterizes numerical bidding actions and communicative attitudes. We examine two complementary aspects of social interaction: inter-agent bargaining dynamics and private-to-public behavioral transformation. Results reveal distinct interaction patterns associated with agreement and breakdown, including greater constructive reciprocity in agreement trials and more frequent conflict escalation in breakdown trials. Furthermore, private and public communicative attitudes often differ even when numerical bids remain unchanged. These findings illustrate how LLM-based bargaining simulations can support a structured analysis of social interaction behaviors in mixed-autonomy traffic.

[NLP-0] Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决统一多模态模型（Unified Multimodal Models, UMMs）在图像生成任务中难以有效利用基于语言的思维链（chain-of-thought）推理的问题，尤其针对现有增强推理的UMMs普遍缺乏大语言模型所具备的测试时扩展性（test-time scaling）与细粒度可控性。其核心挑战源于模态不匹配：推理过程在离散的词元（token）空间中进行，而图像生成则在连续的隐空间中执行，导致信息传递效率低下。为克服这一瓶颈，本文提出连续空间中的潜在推理框架（Latent Reasoning in Continuous space, LARC），通过在连续隐藏状态层面进行推理，避免了传统方法中的词元级限制。该框架包含两个阶段：首先通过课程监督微调（curriculum supervised fine-tuning, SFT）逐步将词元级推理转化为潜在空间推理；随后通过基于信息增益的强化学习（information-gain reinforcement learning, RL）实现无真实标签监督下的潜在推理自演化。实验结果表明，LARC在多个文本到图像生成基准上显著提升生成质量、提示遵循度及组合保真度，尤其在GenEval上较BAGEL提升7个百分点，并展现出清晰的测试时扩展行为，无论在并行或串行策略下均优于基于词元的生成方法。

作者: Byungwoo Jeon,Yoonwoo Jeong,Hyunseok Lee,Minsu Cho,Jinwoo Shin
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); POSTECH(浦项科技大学); RLWRLD

Abstract:Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Latent Reasoning framework in Continuous space (LARC), which alleviates the token-level bottleneck by reasoning over continuous hidden states. Specifically, the training framework consists of two stages: (i) curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (ii) information-gain reinforcement learning (RL). First, the curriculum SFT stage gradually converts token-level reasoning into latent reasoning. Subsequently, the information-gain RL stage self-evolves latent reasoning without ground truth supervision. Experiments across diverse text-to-image generation benchmarks show that LARC consistently improves generation quality, prompt following, and compositional fidelity. Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.

[NLP-1] Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理引擎在支持决策模型（Decision Models）时存在的效率与准确性问题，尤其是现有方法在处理此类轻量级、高可靠性的分类推理任务时，因严重的前缀重复计算开销或输出概率失真而导致性能下降。其核心解决方案是提出Flide——一种高效且精确的推理引擎，通过将决策请求的逻辑树结构与物理执行过程解耦，将其统一编码为单一扁平化的标记流。Flide利用ForkAttention机制，在标准注意力层与循环式门控增量网络（Gated DeltaNet）中借助驻留于GPU的索引实现对请求依赖关系的精准导航，确保每个查询分支的计算结果在精确算术下等价于独立前向传播。通过将分支拓扑直接表达为驻留于GPU的元数据，Flide仅需一组预记录的执行图即可适配多样的请求混合，并支持基于检查点的代理历史恢复。大规模实验表明，Flide在公开的混合模型与决策模型上相较vLLM和SGLang可实现最高达9.5倍的查询加速，同时在总变差距离（total variation distance）上最接近浮点32位参考基准。Flide通过统一物理执行吞吐与数学精确性，为智能体系统中的可扩展、低延迟决策智能奠定了原则性基础。

Abstract:Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. By expressing branch topologies directly in GPU-resident metadata, Flide accommodates diverse request mixtures with a compact set of pre-recorded execution graphs while enabling expanding agent histories to resume from checkpoints saved in earlier passes. Extensive evaluations on public hybrid and decision models demonstrate that Flide answers queries up to 9.5 times faster than vLLM and SGLang while staying closest to a float32 reference in total variation distance. By unifying physical execution throughput with mathematical exactness, Flide establishes a principled foundation for scalable, latency-critical decision intelligence in agent systems.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决将生成式大语言模型（Generative LLM）的排序知识有效迁移至决策模型（Decision Model）中的难题。其核心挑战在于：生成式教师模型通过文档ID序列的排序列表表达偏好，而学生决策模型则依赖首个词元位置的得分来确定排序结果，二者在输出形式与训练机制上存在不匹配。为此，论文提出DecisionRank，采用基于项目空间的在线策略蒸馏（item-space on-policy distillation, OPD）作为关键解决方案。该方法通过将学生模型输出的文档得分排序生成候选排名序列，再由教师模型以该序列为输入提供条件反馈，直接监督学生的得分预测；结合离线排序监督，显著提升了决策模型在通用与推理密集型检索任务（如TREC DL、BEIR、BRIGHT）上的性能。实验表明，即使在1.7B参数规模下，DecisionRank在TREC DL19–23上仍超越其27B的生成式教师模型；在8B参数规模下，不仅优于同类生成式列表级模型，且在TREC DL和BRIGHT上分别实现24.5倍和16.7倍的推理速度提升。

Abstract:Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM’s ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation (OPD). Item-space OPD constructs the student’s rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. A generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditional feedback to directly supervise those scores. Combined with offline ranking supervision, DecisionRank achieves state-of-the-art performance on both general and reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks such as TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT. Across four benchmarks, item-space OPD consistently outperforms alternative training objectives. Even at 1.7B parameters, DecisionRank surpasses its 27B generative teacher on TREC DL19–23. At 8B, it outperforms its generative listwise counterpart while running 24.5\times faster on TREC DL and 16.7\times faster on BRIGHT.

[NLP-3] Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在处理长上下文时因注意力机制（attention）的二次方复杂度（quadratic scaling）导致的计算瓶颈问题。现有方法要么牺牲注意力的表达能力（如滑动窗口或固定状态大小的线性注意力），要么仅实现常数级加速（如索引开销仍为二次方的稀疏注意力）。本文提出一种渐近次二次稀疏注意力方法——Zyphra层级注意力（ZHA），其核心创新在于构建一个分层树状索引结构，对键值缓存（KV cache）中的键进行递归压缩生成层次化摘要。查询通过从树顶逐层向下遍历，高效检索出稀疏的键集合。关键优势在于：随着树深度迭代增加，路由与最终注意力计算的总成本随序列长度呈亚线性增长，从而实现整体注意力计算的次二次（但超线性）复杂度。实验表明，ZHA可仅通过少量（数十亿标记）的KL散度微调即可部署于现有预训练模型，且在长上下文检索、复杂推理、数学求解及智能编码等任务中保持高性能。此外，该方法对树结构几何具有高度鲁棒性，支持高达6层的深层结构。通过建立详尽的性能模型，验证了其在超过百万上下文长度时显著优于竞品，并具备将有效上下文窗口扩展至数亿甚至数十亿标记的潜力。

Abstract:The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention’s expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree’s depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.

[NLP-4] RangeSWA: Training-Free Length Extrapolation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决连续扩散语言模型（continuous diffusion language models）在生成长文本时面临的文本重复、语义漂移及生成质量下降等问题，尤其当生成长度超出训练长度时更为显著。其核心解决方案是提出一种无需额外训练的长度外推方法——RangeSWA。该方法的关键在于融合局部滑动窗口注意力机制（local sliding-window attention）、远程块摘要（remote block summaries）与动态内容检索技术，以在保持局部细节的同时支持长程上下文访问；同时通过位置重映射（positional remapping）、条件注意力校正（conditioning attention correction）以及去噪阶段自适应窗口调度（denoising-stage-adaptive window scheduling），有效缓解因长度外推引发的生成质量退化问题。实验结果表明，RangeSWA能够显著降低长文本生成中的困惑度和重复率，提升生成稳定性与质量。

作者: Guangfu Guo,Xiaoqian Lu,Linsey Pang,Weiran Yao,Haolin Chen,Long Cheng,Kunpeng Liu
机构: Clemson University (克莱姆森大学); University of Ottawa (渥太华大学); PayPal(贝宝); actAVA AI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Continuous diffusion language models show promising potential in text generation tasks, but are prone to problems such as text repetition, semantic drift, and generation quality degradation when the generation length exceeds the training length. To address these challenges, we propose RangeSWA, a training-free length extrapolation method. The method combines local sliding-window attention, remote block summaries, and dynamic content retrieval to preserve local details and support long-range context access. In addition, generation degradation caused by length extrapolation is mitigated through positional remapping, conditioning attention correction, and denoising-stage-adaptive window scheduling. We conducted experiments on multiple continuous diffusion language models, and the results show that RangeSWA can effectively reduce generative perplexity and text repetition rates in long-text generation.

[NLP-5] he Knowledge Layer Model (KLM): Evidence-Visible AI Output Routing Diagnostics and Negative Results

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）回答在缺乏可追溯依据时，难以满足审查者对推理过程透明性与可信度要求的问题。其核心挑战在于：当前AI系统的输出往往看似正确，但其背后的推理路径、证据来源及不确定性评估缺乏显式记录，导致无法进行有效验证。为此，论文提出知识层模型（Knowledge Layer Model, KLM），作为一套开放且与实现无关的推理记录规范，明确包含版本化的认知评估（epistemic assessments）、证据关联关系以及显式的未知项声明。该模型以Nage AI OS中的知识与证据架构SEDIM为参考实现，并基于KLM v0.3版本进行设计。尽管实验数据表明部分基准任务达到91.3%分类准确率，但整体评估受限于内部实验性质、历史数据未验证、评分器缺陷及原始输出缺失等问题，未能形成可靠结论。关键发现包括：多类诊断指标表现极低（如AUC仅为0.008），文本保留率虽经修复显著提升，但仅反映内容完整性而非答案质量；此外，验证工具间一致性虽被报告，但生产级披露未获认可。因此，尽管提出了系统性框架，其有效性仍需独立复现与完整的公开审计支持，目前所有结论均为作者自报，尚未通过外部验证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.42066
作者: Omer Asim Ozturk,Cihan Aydiner
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 47 pages, 1 figure, 14 tables. Includes Appendix A

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI answers require more than apparent correctness: reviewers need to inspect their recorded basis. We introduce the Knowledge Layer Model (KLM), an open, implementation-neutral specification for inference records with versioned epistemic assessments, evidence relations, and explicit unknowns. SEDIM, the knowledge and evidence architecture of Nage AI OS, is a reference implementation. We reference KLM v0.3 (repository tag v0.3.0). Empirical material consists of separate internal experiments, not end-to-end validation. A historical platform-domain routing benchmark reports 137/150 classifications across 15 classes (91.3%; nominal 95% Wilson interval 85.7-94.9%); the numerator is recovered from a rounded summary, and historical example membership is unverified. A native-model weight-path configuration yielded 0/15 successful answers in a corrected two-source test. A capacity-growth comparison could not establish a reliable effect because of a defective legacy scorer and missing original outputs. Lexical and scoped diagnostics each yielded AUC 0.008 for silent-versus-contradicted examples, below the registered minimum of 0.65. Legacy packing lost gold-containing text in 118/221 selected cases; repaired packing retained it in 221/221. These measure text presence, not answer quality. Python and TypeScript verifiers reportedly agreed on six checks per synthetic fixture; a separate production disclosure was not accepted. Restoration, re-derivation, human-rubric support, boundary isolation, and bounded-response evaluations remain proposed. Findings are internal and author-reported; historical observations are distinguished from later reproductions. Evidence visibility does not establish correctness, causal reliance, security, or regulatory compliance. Independent replication and a complete public audit package remain future work.

[NLP-6] PersonaChatBench: Evaluating Chat Assistants with Diverse Simulated Users

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前对话助手中评估方法过于依赖单一合作型用户所带来的局限性，即难以全面反映助手在面对具有不同背景、偏好和沟通风格的多样化用户时的实际表现。其核心问题是：现有评估体系无法有效衡量助手在多变用户情境下的任务胜任力与个性化响应能力。解决方案的关键在于提出PersonaChatBench框架，通过将同一任务与多个由“角色卡”（persona card）定义的模拟用户配对，实现对不同用户个体需求、偏好及交互行为的系统化模拟。该框架在保持任务不变的前提下，动态调整用户属性，从而量化分析助手在不同用户条件下的性能变化。实验结果表明，任务完成度与用户需求满足度存在显著的人格差异与领域依赖性，且任务表现优异的模型并不必然能充分满足特定用户的需求，且模型优势在不同领域间不一致。PersonaChatBench通过分离评估任务成果、需求满足度与模拟器保真度，使这些差异可测量，揭示了传统聚合评分所掩盖的性能鸿沟，为识别助手服务优势与短板提供了依据，并推动开发更具普适性和适应性的对话系统。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.42060
作者: Zheyuan Deng,Taoran Li,Jingwen Zhang,Yuante Li,Dachuan Zhao,Fulei Zhang,Yunkai Zhang,Zhikun Xu,Yajie Liao,Haichao Zhang,Haodi Hu,Cong Wang,Chen Yang,Siyang Wu,Defu Cao,Xu Hu,Haoming Li,Haixin Wang,Robert George,Weizhi Zhang,Yuchu Wang,Zhejian Peng,Yueying Li,Wanting Jiang,Shushu Liang,Zhiyuan Yu,Yifan Wang,Jintao Huang,Yijun Wang,Yuexing Hao,Xiaomin Li
机构: Brown University(布朗大学); Texas AM University(德州农工大学); Harvard University(哈佛大学); Carnegie Mellon University(卡内基梅隆大学); Columbia University(哥伦比亚大学); University of California, Berkeley(加州大学伯克利分校); Arizona State University(亚利桑那州立大学); Northeastern University(东北大学); University of Southern California(南加州大学); University of Chicago(芝加哥大学); The University of Texas at Dallas(德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校); University of California, Los Angeles(加州大学洛杉矶分校); California Institute of Technology(加州理工学院); University of Illinois Chicago(伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校); University of Michigan(密歇根大学); University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign(伊利诺伊大学香槟分校); Massachusetts Institute of Technology(麻省理工学院); Amherst College(阿默斯特学院); Purdue University(普渡大学); The Ohio State University(俄亥俄州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Conversational assistants are expected to help people with diverse backgrounds, preferences, and communication styles. Yet evaluations centered on a single cooperative user provide limited insight into how reliably an assistant serves users with different personas. We introduce PersonaChatBench, a framework for evaluating task competence and responsiveness to diverse user needs. PersonaChatBench pairs the same underlying task with multiple simulated users, each guided by a private persona card that specifies distinct needs, preferences, and interaction behaviors. By holding the task fixed while varying the user, the framework examines how assistant performance changes across user conditions. We evaluate 20 language models across six domains, separately assessing native task outcomes, fulfillment of expressed persona needs, and simulator fidelity. Our results show that task performance and need fulfillment vary across personas and domains. Strong task performance does not necessarily translate into satisfying individual needs, and models’ relative strengths in meeting those needs are not consistent across domains. PersonaChatBench makes these differences measurable, revealing gaps obscured by aggregate scores and helping identify which users an assistant serves well and where adaptation is needed. It provides a basis for evaluating consistency across users and guiding the development of assistants that better accommodate diverse needs in everyday applications.

[NLP-7] CRoS: Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs Improves Accuracy and Reasoning Faithfulness

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理中因果性奖励（Causality Reward）评估的偏差问题，即现有方法通过删除或注入错误等扰动手段评估思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）与最终答案之间的因果关系时，不可避免地改变了每一步推理中的信息内容，导致高因果性得分可能反映的是对扰动引入的信息变化的敏感性，而非真实的因果贡献。这种混淆效应在训练过程中会诱导模型生成信息量更低的思维链，并抑制探索与自我修正行为。为解决此问题，论文提出一种新型因果性度量方法CRoS（Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs），其核心创新在于仅打乱推理步骤的顺序而不改变各步骤的内容，从而在保持信息完整性的同时有效评估因果性。实验结果表明，在Reasoning Gym基准上使用Gemma-3-4B模型进行评估，CRoS在跨域准确率、思维链质量及思维链忠实性方面均显著优于现有方法，尤其在5个未见逻辑与游戏数据集上达到46.8%的准确率，优于最强基线（43.8%），同时在CoT-Pass@K（K=1至128）平均得分43.4%（基线41.4%）和提示承认率（hint acknowledgment score）34.0%（基线20.2%）上也表现出明显优势。

作者: Xiao Yu,Justin Chih-Yao Chen,Zaid Khan,Hyunji Lee,Mohit Bansal
机构: UNC Chapel Hill (北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 17 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the standard method for training language models to reason. However, RLVR typically relies solely on outcome correctness, which does not guarantee that the CoT causally contributes to the final answer. Without this connection, outcome rewards may fail to reinforce high-quality reasoning. Existing causality metrics assess CoT causality by perturbing the CoT, such as deleting reasoning steps or injecting errors, and measuring changes in the final answer. However, these perturbations inevitably alter information in each step. Consequently, high causality scores may reflect sensitivity to information changes introduced by perturbation rather than true causality. Such confounding effects further induce undesirable reasoning behaviors when these metrics are used as training rewards, including generating less informative CoTs and reducing exploration and self-correction. To address this problem, we propose CRoS (Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs), a novel CoT causality metric that perturbs the order of reasoning steps without altering content, thereby preserving information within each step. On Reasoning Gym with Gemma-3-4B, CRoS outperforms existing causality and outcome rewards in out-of-domain accuracy, CoT quality, and CoT faithfulness. Specifically, CRoS achieves 46.8% accuracy on five unseen logic and games datasets, outperforming the strongest baseline (43.8%). It also achieves better CoT quality, consistently outperforming baselines in CoT-Pass@K from K=1 to 128, averaging 43.4% vs. 41.4%. For CoT faithfulness, CRoS achieves a hint acknowledgment score of 34.0% vs. 20.2%.

[NLP-8] Asynchronous Flow Map Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决单步并行语言建模中如何有效利用生成顺序以提升生成序列质量的问题。传统自回归与掩码扩散模型通过迭代方式逐步生成词元，能够自然地利用生成顺序，但现有单步并行模型难以显式建模此类顺序依赖关系。为此，论文提出异步流映射语言模型（asynchronous flow map language models, aFMLMs），其核心创新在于将预测顺序编码为异步流的流映射（flow maps），通过词元级的时间调度（tokenwise time schedule）控制各词元的去噪进度，从而在单次前向传播中实现有序生成。该方法支持预设与可学习的状态自适应调度策略，并建立了有效的流映射蒸馏技术。实验表明，aFMLM在数独求解和GSM8K数学应用题代码生成任务上均达到新的单步生成性能基准，显著提升了并行生成的质量与效率。

作者: Chanhyuk Lee,Wonjung Kim,Patrick Pynadath,Jaehoon Yoo,Satoshi Hayakawa,Ruqi Zhang,Jinwoo Kim,Seunghoon Hong
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); Purdue University(普渡大学); The University of Tokyo(东京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Code available at: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The order in which tokens are predicted in language modeling has a profound impact on the quality of generated sequences. Autoregressive and masked diffusion models iteratively fill in tokens and can exploit such orderings across generation steps, but how to leverage an ordering for one-step parallel language modeling is unclear. We introduce asynchronous flow map language models (aFMLMs), which incorporate prediction order into one-step modeling by learning the flow maps of asynchronous flows. These flows specify an ordering through a tokenwise time schedule that controls the relative denoising progress of tokens. We formulate a general class of asynchronous flows that admit both prescribed and learned, state-adaptive schedules, show that they define valid flow maps, and develop new methods for their flow map distillation. The resulting models can generate all tokens in a single forward pass by internalizing the ordering encoded in the flow into their hidden computations. On Sudoku solving and code generation for GSM8K math word problems, aFMLM establishes new state-of-the-art one-step performance.

[NLP-9] urnTurk-GPT : Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决土耳其语对话中话轮转换（turn-taking）预测的难题，即在实时语音流处理场景下准确判断说话人何时结束发言。其核心挑战在于：如何在无标点、小写化且非分句的文本流中，仅基于连续文本序列识别出自然对话中的话轮终止点，尤其在面对未见说话者或不同录音环境时保持鲁棒性。解决方案的关键在于提出并训练了TurnTurk-GPT——一个通过在合成与真实对话数据上微调土耳其语GPT-2模型，并采用TurnGPT目标函数进行优化的生成式端到端话轮转换预测器。该方法的核心创新在于将土耳其语特有的动词后置形态学特征（verb-final morphology）作为关键的句末提示信号，实验证明去除话轮末尾词的词尾会使其平均精度（AP）下降高达44%，显著高于内部词的2%下降，证实了形态学线索对土耳其语话轮终结判别的决定性作用。此外，研究构建了严格的评估协议，包含记录无关与说话人无关的交叉验证、嵌套阈值选择及配对聚类自助法检验，确保结果可靠性。实验表明，TurnTurk-GPT在多数情况下优于多语言基线模型，在已见说话者上超越零样本模型，但在未见说话者上二者无统计差异，凸显其对训练数据覆盖度的依赖。模型与评估框架均已公开发布，为后续研究提供可复现基准。

机构: Ata Technology Platforms(阿塔科技平台)

Abstract:This paper presents TurnTurk-GPT, a text-based turn-taking predictor for Turkish obtained by fine-tuning a Turkish GPT-2 model with the TurnGPT objective on synthetic and real dialogue, and evaluates it on real Turkish conversation against rule baselines, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a widely used multilingual end-of-turn detector. Evaluation uses word-level decision points on unpunctuated, lower-cased text approximating the output of streaming speech recognisers, recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint folds, nested threshold selection and paired cluster bootstrap tests. TurnTurk-GPT outperforms the multilingual detector under both recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation. It outperforms the zero-shot language model only when the test speakers occur in training; on unseen speakers the two are statistically indistinguishable. Removing the suffixes of the turn-final word reduces AP by up to 44%, against 2% for a sentence-internal word, locating the Turkish end-of-turn cue in verb-final morphology. Synthetic dialogue alone yields the weakest trained model, and when a speaker pauses the zero-shot and multilingual baselines remain close to chance. The model and the evaluation protocol are publicly released.

[NLP-10] Less Loss Fixed Weights: Logit Corrections for Forgetting

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型在指令微调或领域继续预训练后出现的“遗忘”问题，即模型在标准网络文本预测能力上的退化。其核心挑战在于如何在不重新训练模型的前提下，通过简单、固定的后处理机制恢复模型对原始分布文本的生成性能。解决方案的关键在于引入一个针对每个词元（token）的固定偏置（vocabulary bias），并结合温度参数（temperature）进行调整，以修正模型输出概率分布的偏差。实验表明，在14组不同规模（1B至7B参数）的基础与衍生模型中，仅使用词汇偏置时，最大可恢复性能提升不足10%；而结合温度调节后，最高可恢复达36%。值得注意的是，经过数学领域继续预训练的模型遗忘最严重且几乎无法恢复。此外，在模拟随机损伤的控制实验中，即使不存在人为植入的偏置或温度变化，该方法仍能恢复29%的性能损失，表明该策略具备一定的鲁棒性。然而，大部分真实场景下的性能下降仍超出该受限调整框架的修复范围，说明“遗忘”现象具有深层次的表征层面损伤。

作者: Hanyu Yang
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a language model is fine-tuned to follow instructions, or further pretrained on a new subject, it often gets worse at predicting standard web text. This is known as “forgetting.” We ask whether this loss can be undone by simple, fixed adjustments to the model’s final token predictions. Across 14 pairs of base and derived models, from 1B to 7B parameters, we fitted a fixed bonus or penalty for each token (a vocabulary bias), alone or together with a temperature. On text held out from correction fitting, the largest top-4K bias recovery estimate is under 10%, with loss conditional on the retained vocabulary. Combining the bias with a temperature recovers up to 36%. Models further pretrained on math lose the most and recover almost nothing. Finally, in a controlled simulation where a model is damaged at random, with no planted bias or temperature change, the bias-plus-temperature fix still recovers 29%. Most of the real-model loss increase stays out of reach of our restricted fits.

[NLP-11] DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决线性注意力（Linear attention）在长序列建模中因有限状态记忆而导致的长距离信息检索能力受限的问题。其核心挑战在于门控线性递归（Gated Linear Recurrences）中的记忆保留机制依赖于状态衰减，而该衰减由门控参数 AlogA_{\text{log}}Alog​ 和 dt_biasdt\_biasdt_bias 以及输入激活共同决定，且训练后这些参数与初始值高度相关，凸显了初始化策略的重要性。为此，论文提出双轴记忆初始化（Dual-Axis Memory Initialization, DAMI），在训练前联合配置 AlogA_{\text{log}}Alog​ 与 dt_biasdt\_biasdt_bias：一方面为不同注意力头分配几何级数的时间尺度以适应多样化的检索距离；另一方面在层间构建“低-高-低”的输入敏感性分布，从而优化记忆保留与动态响应。DAMI仅通过一个小激活样本对GDN系列模型进行校准，无需引入额外可训练参数。实验表明，在GDN、KDA、GDN2、Mamba-2和RWKV-7等多种架构上，DAMI相较于随机初始化基线，平均提升了5.29至16.71个百分点的RULER风格检索准确率，同时在语言建模、常识推理及2K真实世界检索任务上的性能保持相当。

作者: Zhangchi Feng,Harry Jiang,Yangyifei Luo,Ray Zhang,Richong Zhang
机构: SpeedAI; Beihang University (北京航空航天大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Linear attention scales linearly with sequence length, but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval. In gated linear recurrences, memory retention depends on state decay, which is shaped jointly by gate parameters A_log and dt_bias and by input activations. In controlled Gated DeltaNet (GDN) experiments, both parameters remain highly correlated with their initial values after training, highlighting the importance of initialization. Therefore, we introduce Dual-Axis Memory Initialization (DAMI), which jointly configures these parameters before training. DAMI assigns geometric timescales across heads for varied retrieval distances and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers. A small activation sample calibrates the GDN-family implementation to match both behavioral targets without adding trainable parameters. Across GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7, DAMI improves average RULER-style retrieval accuracy by 5.29 to 16.71 percentage points over the corresponding random-initialization baselines. Performance on language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and 2K real-world retrieval remains broadly comparable to those baselines. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-12] Aligning MLLM s with the Latent Structure of Human Cognition via Behavior-Derived Semantic Dimensions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在推理任务中表现优异，但其内部表征与人类认知的潜在结构之间是否存在对齐的问题。核心挑战在于，尽管MLLMs能完成复杂任务，但其决策机制是否符合人类基于多维心理表征进行相似性判断的认知过程尚不明确。为此，本文提出一种新型对齐框架，通过构建基于人类行为数据的语义嵌入空间——该空间由470万条人类“奇数出列”（Odd-One-Out, O1O）判断推导出的66个可解释维度构成，为每个三元组样本识别最显著的决策维度，并将其转化为以维度为基础的语言化推理理由（dimension-grounded linguistic rationale）。这一设计使MLLMs不仅学习最终选择结果，还学习与人类行为准则一致的解释逻辑。实验表明，该方法显著提升了模型与人类相似性判断的一致性，同时在标准多模态基准测试上保持竞争力；进一步利用独立的fMRI自然场景数据集（NSD）进行搜索光束表示相似性分析（searchlight Representational Similarity Analysis, RSA），发现模型表征与人类大脑表征之间的相似性增强。研究结果揭示了一条数据驱动的路径，可将人类认知结构系统性地融入MLLMs的对齐过程中。

作者: Ning E,Changde Du,Yizhuo Lu,Huiguang He
机构: ShanghaiTech University (上海科技大学); Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院); Zhongguancun Academy (中关村学院); University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations and decision criteria align with the latent structure of human cognition. In this work, we propose a novel framework to align MLLMs with the multidimensional mental representations underlying human similarity judgements. We build on a previously established behavior-derived semantic embedding space, in which objects are represented along 66 interpretable dimensions derived from 4.70 million human Odd-One-Out (O1O) judgements. For each triplet, we infer the most salient decision dimension and convert it into a dimension-grounded linguistic rationale. This enables MLLMs to learn both the final choice and a justification consistent with the inferred behavioral criterion. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves model consistency with human similarity judgements while retaining competitive performance on standard multimodal benchmarks. Furthermore, using searchlight Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) on an independent fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we observe increased representational alignment between model and human. Ultimately, our findings point to a data-driven route for incorporating human cognitive structure into MLLMs alignment. The code is available \hrefthis https URLhere.

[NLP-13] How Much Can Tool Calls Reveal About You? Privacy Leakage from Tool-Call Traces

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的智能体在通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）与外部工具交互时，其产生的工具调用轨迹（tool-call traces）可能泄露用户行为特征，从而导致用户画像被推断的隐私风险问题。其解决方案的关键在于构建了一个名为PrivacyTrace的基准测试集，包含1,000个合成用户画像和跨四个领域、4,000条智能体轨迹，基于25个真实MCP服务器生成的工具调用数据。实验表明，仅通过协议合规的工具调用行为即可实现26.25%的用户画像推断成功率，显著高于基于先验猜测的17.97%，且分析揭示工具参数和返回结果是主要的信息源，跨会话轨迹关联进一步加剧了隐私泄露风险。研究证实MCP工具调用轨迹可作为有效的行为侧信道，推动了面向代理-工具交互场景的隐私保护机制研发。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41885
作者: Donghang Duan,Qingyu Liu,Yifei Liu,Na Zou,Xia Hu,Dongrui Liu
机构: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (上海人工智能实验室); University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (电子科技大学); The University of Sydney (悉尼大学)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 24 pages, 12 figures, 8 tables, including references and appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM)-based agents interact with external tools through protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), producing tool-call traces that may expose behavioral signals about users. In this work, we systematically study the risk of user-profile inference from MCP tool-call traces, where observers infer user attributes from protocol-valid tool interactions without access to user conversations. We introduce PrivacyTrace, a benchmark containing 1,000 synthetic user profiles and 4,000 agent trajectories across four domains, generated with real MCP tools from 25 servers. Experiments with four mainstream LLM attackers show that tool-call traces enable a 26.25% attack success rate for profile inference, compared with 17.97% from prior-based guessing. Further analysis reveals that tool arguments and returned results provide the main trace-grounded evidence, while linking traces across sessions further amplifies profiling risk. These findings demonstrate that MCP tool-call traces can act as effective behavioral side channels for user profiling, motivating the development of privacy-aware mechanisms for agent-tool interactions. Code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-14] xt as an Index for Zero-Shot Cross-Domain Knowledge Tracing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决零样本跨域知识追踪（zero-shot cross-domain knowledge tracing, ZS-CKT）问题，即在目标平台缺乏历史答题记录的情况下，如何利用源域的训练数据对学生的未来答题行为进行准确预测。现有方法依赖于问题语义进行迁移，但不同平台间的问题语义存在显著差异，严重限制了模型的可迁移性。其解决方案的关键在于提出TIZSKT（Text-Indexing Zero-shot Knowledge Tracing），通过将行为序列建模与领域特定的历史证据构建解耦，并以文本作为索引而非直接可迁移的表示。具体而言，该方法采用“掌握动态编码器”（Mastery-Dynamics Encoder）在不依赖问题标识符或文本嵌入的情况下学习正确性动态；通过“领域局部问题定位”（Domain-Local Question Addressing）使用冻结的文本编码器和无监督的领域内投影生成固定的问题地址；进而利用“文本索引核”（Text-Addressing Kernel）基于这些地址聚合学生过往表现，形成针对每个问题的历史正确性概要；同时引入“跨段延续机制”（Cross-Segment Continuation）在不扩展行为编码器输入序列的前提下保留早期响应信息；最后通过“证据量读出”（Evidence-Volume Read-Out）保留归一化过程中丢失的总核质量，并将其对数压缩值与行为状态及历史正确性概要结合以预测下一次作答。所有可训练参数均在源域上学习完成，目标域推理仅需公开的问题文本和当前学生的观测历史，无需目标域训练。在三个公开数据集上的留一域外实验表明，TIZSKT在所有目标域上均达到最高平均AUC和准确率，消融实验进一步验证了文本索引与跨段延续机制的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41883
作者: Yin Yi,Haiping Ma,Siyu Song,Ziwen Wang,Shangshang Yang
机构: Institutes of Physical Science and Information Technology, Anhui University, Hefei, China; School of Computer Science and Technology, East China Normal University, Shanghai, China; School of Computer Science and Technology, Anhui University, Hefei, China
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 10 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Knowledge tracing (KT) predicts a student’s next response from their history. New platforms often have question texts but no response logs for training, motivating zero-shot cross-domain KT. Existing transfer and cold-start methods use question semantics, but cross-platform semantic discrepancies limit transferability. We propose TIZSKT, which separates behavioral sequence modeling from domain-local historical evidence construction and uses text as an index rather than a directly transferable predictive representation. The Mastery-Dynamics Encoder learns correctness dynamics without question identifiers or text embeddings. Domain-Local Question Addressing builds fixed question addresses using a frozen text encoder and an unsupervised per-domain projection. The Text-Addressing Kernel uses these addresses to aggregate the current student’s previous outcomes into a question-specific historical correctness summary. Cross-Segment Continuation retains access to earlier responses without extending the behavioral encoder’s input sequence. Evidence-Volume Read-Out preserves the total kernel mass discarded by normalization and combines its log-compressed value with the behavioral state and historical correctness summary to predict the next response. All trainable parameters are learned from source domains; target inference uses public question texts and the current student’s observed history without target-domain training. Leave-one-domain-out experiments on three public datasets show that TIZSKT achieves the highest mean AUC and accuracy among evaluated baselines on all target domains. Ablations confirm the contributions of text addressing and cross-segment continuation.

[NLP-15] Iterated Integrals as Lexical Fingerprints: Path Signature Embeddings for Lexical Similarity NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有句子嵌入方法在捕捉表面级词汇结构（lexical structure）与词序信息方面的局限性问题。尽管句子嵌入通常用于语义泛化，但其潜在的几何结构实际上隐含了词汇层面的特性，而这一关系尚未被充分理解。传统浅层池化方法（如平均池化）会丢失词序信息，而深层Transformer模型则因计算复杂性和不可解释的空间导致词汇对齐关系被掩盖。为此，本文提出基于Word2Vec词向量轨迹的路径签名（path signature）构建句子嵌入，利用粗糙路径理论中的迭代积分，以几何上可处理的方式显式建模序列和词汇结构。通过大量消融实验，验证了路径签名在表征字符级编辑距离（如Levenshtein、字符TF-IDF）方面显著优于传统方法，其中深度为2的签名在字符与词级敏感度之间达到最优平衡。此外，研究发现关键的词汇方差集中于一个高度紧凑的主成分分析（PCA）子空间，且路径签名能结构性地保留并量化词序信息。因此，路径签名并非语义泛化的工具，而是作为严谨的数学工具，显式编码离散词汇结构与词序，为词汇追踪提供了一种可解释的、非黑箱替代方案。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41855
作者: Raj Shekhar Singh,Pratham Agarwal
机构: Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee(印度理工学院，鲁尔基); Roorkee, Uttarakhand, India(鲁尔基，北阿坎德邦，印度)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: accepted in NeurIPS 2026 LP4FM Workshop

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While sentence embeddings are primarily designed for semantic generalization, their latent geometry implicitly encodes surface-level lexical properties, a relationship that remains poorly understood. Shallow pooling methods discard word order, while deep Transformer models obscure these lexical alignments behind computational complexity and uninterpretable spaces. We propose constructing sentence embeddings via the path signature of Word2Vec trajectories, leveraging the iterated integrals of rough path theory to create representations that explicitly capture sequential and lexical structure in a geometrically tractable manner. Through extensive ablations spanning Word2Vec dimensions, signature depths, and PCA compression, we correlate embedding distances against five lexical string metrics: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, word Jaccard, phoneme Levenshtein, and character TF-IDF. We reveal that while average pooling almost entirely fails to capture character-level edit distances, path signatures strongly align with them, with depth 2 signatures optimally balancing character and word-level sensitivities. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the critical lexical variance is concentrated in a highly compact PCA subspace, and unlike pooling, signatures structurally preserve and quantify word order. These findings establish path signatures not as semantic generalizers, but as rigorous mathematical lenses that explicitly encode discrete lexical structures and word order, offering an interpretable alternative to opaque deep learning for lexical tracking.

[NLP-16] Stepwise-Querying: Distilling Reasoning without Access to Teacher Chain-of-Thought

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在黑盒（black-box）设置下，大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）作为教师（teacher）仅提供最终答案和简略解题过程时，导致中间推理步骤与有效性验证信息不可用，从而限制了生成式AI（Generative AI）在小模型（student）知识蒸馏中获取充分推理监督的问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出**分步查询（Stepwise Querying）方法：通过向同一教师进行独立的多轮查询，分别请求每个解题步骤的中间推导、有效性检查及修正，进而整合形成完整的解题序列，用于标准的监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）。该方法无需访问教师内部的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）轨迹即可有效获取结构化推理信号。此外，作者引入分步解释信息增益（Stepwise Explanation Information Gain, SEIG）**作为诊断指标，量化不同解释粒度对模型性能的影响。实验表明，在数学与代码四类基准测试中，该方法在16次对比中有14次优于三个基线方法；且分析显示，即使包含错误答案的推理路径，只要保留有效的中间推理过程仍具有价值，而进一步分解步骤带来的收益有限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41769
作者: Dicong Yu,Wenhua Wang,Tian Wang
机构: Beijing Normal University (北京师范大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 15 pages, 7 figures, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reasoning distillation is widely used to transfer the reasoning capabilities of large language models to smaller students through teacher-generated supervision. In the black-box setting, however, teachers may expose only final answers and brief solutions, leaving intermediate calculations and validity conditions unavailable and thus limiting the reasoning supervision available for distillation. We propose Stepwise Querying, which elicits step-specific explanations without requiring access to the teacher’s internal chain-of-thought (CoT) traces. Independent queries to the same teacher request intermediate derivations, validity checks, and corrections for individual steps, the assembled solutions are then used for standard supervised fine-tuning. Across two teachers, two students, and four mathematics and code benchmarks, our method achieves the highest score in 14 of 16 comparisons with three baselines. We further introduce Stepwise Explanation Information Gain (SEIG), a diagnostic based on the log-ratio of a frozen student’s probabilities of correct step completion under stepwise and global explanations. Analyses on GSM8K show that incorrect-answer trajectories can remain useful when they preserve valid intermediate reasoning, while further decomposition yields limited additional gains.

[NLP-17] ask Vectors Can Be Linearly Decomposed into Interpretable and Controllable Components

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）中任务向量（Task Vectors, TVs）作为黑箱式控制指令缺乏可解释性与功能结构理解的问题。现有方法将TVs视为从隐藏状态中提取的孤立方向，未能揭示其内部的功能构成。为此，作者受上下文学习（in-context learning）可分解为任务识别（Task Recognition, TR）与任务学习（Task Learning, TL）的启发，提出一种基于TR/TL框架的TV分解方法，通过候选标签解嵌入（candidate-label unembeddings）将单个TV拆分为具有明确功能意义的TR、TL及残差（residual）组件。该方案的核心在于利用贝叶斯优化对TR和TL分量的权重进行联合调优，以实现更有效的模型干预。实验在多种模型架构、分类任务以及基于指令和示范的TVs上验证了该方法的有效性：相较于原始TVs，TR/TL优化显著提升性能，尤其在指令型TVs上表现更稳定可靠；此外，对分解后组件的独立干预在logit层面产生与预期功能一致的作用，进一步证实了各组件的功能可解释性。研究结果表明，TVs并非不可分割的单一控制方向，而是可被解构为具备功能性意义的子组件，从而为模型行为的解释与精准调控提供了新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41743
作者: Yukiya Horiba,Hakaze Cho,Takahiro Yakoh
机构: Keio University(庆应义塾大学); RIKEN(理化学研究所); Tohoku University(东北大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Task Vectors (TVs) provide a compact way to steer large language models, but they are typically treated as atomized directions merely extracted from hidden states, leaving their internal functional structure poorly understood. Motivated by prior work that decomposes in-context learning into Task Recognition (TR) and Task Learning (TL), we ask whether a single TV can likewise be decomposed into functionally meaningful components. We formulate a TR/TL-based decomposition from candidate-label unembeddings, separating each TV into TR, TL, and residual components, and try to optimize the TR and TL coefficients using Bayesian optimization for more effective intervention. We evaluate this formulation across multiple model families, classification tasks, and both instruction- and demonstration-based TVs. Across these settings, TR/TL-based optimization identifies intervention directions that outperform the original TVs. Although optimization over random directions can also improve performance, TR/TL-based search yields more reliable gains, particularly for instruction-based TVs. Moreover, isolated interventions on the decomposed components produce distinct logit-level effects that are consistent with their intended functional roles. Together, these results suggest that TVs are not monolithic steering directions, but can be decomposed into functionally meaningful components that support both interpretation and control.

[NLP-18] Leakage-Controlled Structure-Preserving Augmentation and Template-Aware Evaluation for Bangla Symptom-Based Disease Prediction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决孟加拉语症状-疾病预测中因数据集小、类别不平衡以及训练样本与测试样本间高度相似性（仅差一个或两个症状）所导致的模型评估偏差问题。其核心解决方案是引入仅在训练阶段应用的非对称伯努利扰动（train-only asymmetric Bernoulli perturbation），通过生成具有轻微变异的症状组合来增强训练数据的多样性，从而提升模型泛化能力。关键在于将数据增强与超参数调优分离，采用2×2实验设计，结合精确复制、随机过采样、类别加权和SMOTEN等多种平衡策略进行对照。结果表明，尽管伯努利朴素贝叶斯（BNB）在平均准确率上表现最佳（97.50%），但其增益在多重检验校正后不显著；而梯度提升树模型（如XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost）则获得显著性能提升，分别提高18.10、28.45和10.09个百分点。此外，通过汉明距离审计发现，91.0%的标准测试样本与训练数据仅相差一个症状位，说明现有基准测试存在模板接近性问题，因此模型在真实场景下的鲁棒性需结合症状空间邻近性综合评估。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41733
作者: Sabah Nushra,Shovan Samanta Turzo,Moinul Hossain,Md Kishor Morol
机构: Islamic University of Technology (伊斯兰科技大学); Daffodil International University (达福迪国际大学); American International University–Bangladesh (美国国际大学—孟加拉国分校); ELITE Research Lab (精英研究实验室)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 6 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Bangla symptom-based disease prediction is commonly evaluated on a small, imbalanced structured benchmark containing many profiles that differ by only one or two symptoms. We test whether train-only asymmetric Bernoulli perturbation improves classification using 725 unique profiles spanning 85 diseases and 172 binary symptoms. Experiments use ten repeated real-profile holdouts and parent-grouped inner cross-validation. The 2 x 2 design separates augmentation from hyperparameter tuning, with exact duplication, random oversampling, class weighting, and SMOTEN as balancing controls. For Bernoulli Naive Bayes (BNB), the gain over tuned raw training does not withstand Holm correction, although BNB attains the highest mean accuracy (97.50%). The boosted-tree models benefit substantially: XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost improve by 18.10, 28.45, and 10.09 percentage points, respectively. A Hamming-distance audit places 91.0% of standard held-out profiles within one symptom bit of the training data. Accuracy decreases on a same-disease 1-bit-purged challenge; nevertheless, XGBoost and LightGBM retain large augmentation gains. We also evaluate robustness to missing and spurious symptoms and the faithfulness of BNB explanations. Overall, Bernoulli perturbation is useful for some model families, but benchmark accuracy should be interpreted together with template proximity.

[NLP-19] From Training Exposure to Membership Evidence: A Controlled Study of OLMo 2

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型训练数据成员身份推断（membership inference, MI）评估中因事后采样导致的分布偏移问题，以及由此引发的版权、隐私和基准污染等关键挑战。传统MI评估在模型训练完成后才收集成员与非成员样本，其成功可能源于数据分布变化而非真实成员性，而失败则难以得出明确结论。本文通过重新运行OLMo 2 1B模型的中期训练阶段，在7,814个领域与难度匹配的数据对中，以随机方式插入一个文档并保留另一个作为对照，构建了可控的“反事实”实验环境。其核心解决方案在于引入基于相同种子生成的反事实模型作为参考，通过比较目标模型与反事实模型在特定文档上的似然比（reference ratio），实现更准确的成员性检测。结果显示，该方法在跨领域统一阈值下可实现1%假阳性率（FPR）时捕获3.8%的成员，且受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）达0.767；当使用13组匹配对进行配对检验时，具备80%功效在5%显著性水平下检测到训练痕迹。此外，使用不同种子训练的参考模型仍能恢复92%的反事实优势，而无需参考的攻击方法在跨领域汇总后仅略高于随机水平（差值≤0.07）。尽管完整官方后训练流程仍保留约89%的平均效应，但个体文档层面的显著变异性限制了精准的成员推断能力。研究团队将公开检查点、逐标记对数概率及评估数据集，代码亦已开源。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41732
作者: Ali Banaei,Muhammad Shahab Shahzad,Gerald Q. Maguire Jr.,Marco Chiesa,Dejan Kostić
机构: KTH Royal Institute of Technology (皇家理工学院)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 20 pages, 11 figures. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Whether a language model was trained on a document matters for copyright, privacy, and benchmark contamination. Yet most membership-inference (MI) evaluations on language models collect members and non-members after the fact, so success may reflect distribution shift and failure is inconclusive. We re-ran OLMo 2 1B’s official 50-billion-token mid-training stage, replacing selected training chunks with documents from 7,814 pairs matched on domain and difficulty. For each pair, a coin flip determined which document was inserted and which was held out. The run released by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) from the same seed saw identical data everywhere else and serves as the counterfactual. One exposure raises a previously unseen document’s likelihood on average but rarely identifies it. Using the counterfactual as reference, the reference ratio has an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.767 but, with one threshold across domains, catches 3.8% of members at a 1% false-positive rate (FPR). In contrast, 13 matched pairs give a paired test 80% power at the 5% level to detect training on a collection, given same-domain non-members and a close reference. A reference trained with another seed recovers 92% of the counterfactual’s AUC advantage over chance, whereas reference-free attacks stay within 0.07 of chance when pooled over domains. The full official post-training recipe, re-run on both models, leaves 89% of the average effect. Even with a closely matched reference, substantial document-level variability limits individual membership inference. We will release the checkpoints, per-token log-probabilities, and the evaluation documents; the code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-20] UpLoop: Training Looped Transformers via Upcycling at No Extra Pretraining Compute

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决循环式语言模型（Looped Language Models）在提升推理能力时伴随的训练计算成本（如浮点运算量，FLOPs）急剧增加的问题。尽管通过共享权重的重复计算可增强模型执行深度而无需引入额外参数，但每轮迭代均导致训练开销上升，限制了其实际应用。为此，论文提出一种名为UpLoop的预训练策略，其核心创新在于通过“再利用”（upcycling）机制，在保持最终参数量、总训练词元数和总训练FLOPs与标准密集型基线完全一致的前提下，实现对循环式Transformer的有效训练。具体而言，UpLoop从浅层网络开始，逐步通过复制已学习层来增加模型深度，并将早期训练中节省的计算资源用于后期对共享中间模块的多次执行。实验结果表明，该方法在不同模型规模下均显著提升了语言建模及下游任务性能，尤其在13亿参数规模下，22项下游任务的平均得分从22.99提升至27.52；此外，经监督微调后，该方法在数学推理任务上也展现出明显优势。

作者: Cheng Liang,Tengfei Zhang,Ya Zhang,Yanfeng Wang,Zhouhan Lin
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped language models can strengthen reasoning through repeated computation with shared weights, increasing execution depth without adding independent parameters. However, each additional pass increases training floating-point operations (FLOPs), making these gains more expensive to obtain. To address this cost, we propose UpLoop, a pretraining schedule that uses upcycling to train looped Transformers while exactly matching a standard dense baseline in final parameter count, total training tokens, and training FLOPs. Specifically, UpLoop begins with a shallow Transformer, progressively grows its depth by copying learned layers, and uses the computation saved early to support repeated execution of a shared middle block later in training. Experiments across model scales show improvements in language modeling and downstream performance, with the average score across 22 downstream tasks increasing from 22.99 to 27.52 at 1.3B parameters. These gains also extend to mathematical reasoning after supervised fine-tuning.

[NLP-21] GraphNIAH: A Benchmark for Long-Context Reasoning over Real-World Graphs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有“针尖对草堆”（Needle-in-a-Haystack, NIAH）基准测试在评估大语言模型（LLM）从长文本中检索微小相关事实能力时所面临的四大局限性：依赖合成数据导致泛化性不足、复用已有数据集存在基准污染风险、依赖人工标注带来维护成本高且易引发污染、以及对多跳推理的过度简化（即每一步推理均显而易见，缺乏真实世界中所需的多路径规划能力）。为克服这些问题，论文提出一个名为GraphNIAH的动态基准，其构建基于模型知识截止日期之后发表的科学论文之间的真实引用关系，确保数据来源真实且避免基准污染。该基准通过自动化流程从引用图中采样代表性子图，并将其转化为具有可验证答案的长上下文问答样本，从而更真实地模拟复杂多跳推理场景。实验评估了来自GPT-5.6、Gemini-3和Qwen3.5系列的八款大模型，结果表明：随着推理路径深度增加（如16步和32步），模型准确率显著下降，在回答是/否类问题时表现接近随机猜测（主要倾向回答“否”），且四款模型未能正确处理计数类问题，其余模型性能随子图规模增大而恶化。这表明当前主流大模型虽在上下文中包含所需全部事实，却往往在未完成完整推理路径前就停止搜索，暴露出其在长程依赖建模与系统性推理方面的根本缺陷。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41704
作者: Minh-Nam Tran,Abulhair Saparov
机构: Purdue University (普渡大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) benchmark was introduced as a test for measuring a model’s ability to find small relevant facts within a very large body of input text. However, existing NIAH benchmarks each suffer from one or more of the following limitations: (1) reliance on synthetic data, so their evaluations may not generalize to real-world settings; (2) reuse of previously published datasets, leading to the risk of benchmark contamination; (3) dependence on manual annotation, which requires human effort to create and update data and is prone to future benchmark contamination; and (4) unrealistic simplification of long-context multi-hop reasoning where each next step is trivial given previous steps, while real-world reasoning often requires planning over multiple possible proof paths. To address these limitations, we introduce \Benchmark, a dynamic benchmark built from real citation relationships among scientific papers published after the evaluated models’ knowledge cutoff date, which utilizes real-world information while ensuring no benchmark contamination. The fully automated benchmark construction pipeline samples representative subgraphs of the citation graph formed by these papers and converts each subgraph into a long-context QA example with a verifiable answer. We use GraphNIAH to evaluate eight LLMs from the GPT-5.6, Gemini-3, and Qwen3.5 families. We find that accuracy falls as questions require longer reasoning paths: at question depths of 16 and 32, the GPT-5.6 and Qwen3.5 models answer YES/NO questions no better than random guessing, mostly by answering NO; four of the eight models answer no counting example correctly, and the others model get worse as the subgraph size increases. These findings suggest that current LLMs often stop searching the citation relationships in their context before they reach the answer, even though every fact they need is in the context.

[NLP-22] Precision–Recall Trade-off on the Inference Level for LLM s in Grammatical Error Correction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在语法错误纠正（Grammatical Error Correction, GEC）任务中缺乏对精确率-召回率（precision–recall）权衡进行推理时动态调控的问题。尽管现有方法通过全微调或提示工程（prompt-based approaches）已实现较强的纠错性能，但其对生成行为的控制能力有限，尤其在需要灵活平衡纠正准确性与完整性时表现不足。本文的关键解决方案是利用推理阶段的重复惩罚（repetition penalty）参数，实现对生成过程的可控调节：通过调整该参数，可在不改变模型架构、训练流程或提示内容的前提下，动态优化GEC中的精确率与召回率之间的权衡。实验结果表明，基于重复惩罚的解码策略能够有效实现推理时的精度-召回控制，其概念上与序列到序列模型中的对齐-预测解码（Align-and-Predict Decoding, APD）等方法相关，同时具备简单性与对现有LLMs的广泛适用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41698
作者: Ryszard Staruch,Filip Graliński
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) have recently been adopted for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC), achieving strong performance via both full fine-tuning and prompt-based approaches. As probabilistic sequence models, LLMs expose inference-time parameters that directly modify token generation behavior; however, their potential for controlling GEC-specific trade-offs has not been systematically studied. In this work, we investigate decoding strategies for grammatical error correction. We show that the repetition penalty parameter enables controllable adjustment of the precision–recall trade-off at inference time, without modifying the model architecture, training procedure, or prompt. Through experiments on standard GEC benchmarks, we demonstrate that repetition-penalty-based decoding enables inference-time control of the precision–recall balance, conceptually related to methods previously proposed for sequence-to-sequence GEC models, such as Align-and-Predict Decoding (APD), while remaining simple and broadly applicable to existing LLMs that expose inference-time decoding penalties.

[NLP-23] SBPO: Tree-Structured Branching for Policy Optimization in Interactive Language Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决从终端结果（terminal outcomes）训练交互式语言代理时面临的三个相互关联的核心问题：如何采样任务与状态的延续（continuations）、如何将延迟反馈（delayed feedback）分配给具体决策、以及如何对多标记动作（multi-token actions）进行标记损失聚合。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种树结构的“采样-更新”范式（TSBPO），在单一训练循环中统一处理上述挑战。该方法通过一个基于似然拟合的根节点/分支分配器，利用保留的任务与状态证据，聚焦于那些在固定回溯预算下可能产生对比性终端结果的延续路径；在重构的物理树结构上，采用轨迹优势（trajectory advantages）比较相邻子段的即时收益，并通过观察组步级优势（observation-group step advantages）在相同任务/观测状态下对比最终结果；代理策略则对每个完整响应中的截断标记代理损失求和，并在活跃回合间进行归一化，从而避免了传统策略梯度中对响应长度的平均化处理。实验表明，在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型基础上，该方法在ALFWorld基准上实现了97.79%的已见任务成功率与96.64%的未见任务成功率，在WebShop上每500个测试目标均实现81.07%的单集成功率，且消融实验验证了步骤级损失加权的有效性，支持所提训练配置在两个交互式基准上的优越性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41697
作者: Rui Yu,Chong Mu,Jinchuan Zhang
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
