点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a language model invents a Qur’anic verse or hadith, it gives false authority to text that readers may treat as sacred. Existing Islamic hallucination benchmarks are largely Arabic and often closed-ended, while Bengali resources mainly study general-domain hallucination or factual knowledge. We introduce BILAL-BENCH, a 240-question expert-verified benchmark for open-ended Islamic-source fabrication in Bengali. It covers Qur’anic attribution, hadith, fiqh, contemporary issues, and adversarial false-premise prompts, and uses a two-axis rubric that separates source errors from assertiveness. We evaluate seven open-weight models from 1B to 120B on 1,680 double-annotated responses. Six of the seven models confidently fabricate on 79.3-95.3% of source-production questions, with no monotonic improvement from scale. Hadith provenance is the weakest category across models: only two of 315 responses are correct and correctly sourced. The two 8B BanglaLLaMA variants have similar confident-fabrication rates but different error profiles. Models vary far more in whether they withhold a claim they cannot support than in source accuracy: appropriate abstention or false-premise correction ranges from 6 to 46 responses across the benchmark, and does not track parameter count.

[NLP-60] he psychophysics of affect in large language models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在决策过程中如何将结果映射为情感体验，以及这些情感映射是否被用于实际选择的问题。当前大语言模型（LLMs）正日益融入决策工作流，但其对结果情感的感知机制尚不明确。研究发现，当结果独立评估时，模型对收益和损失的情感反应表现出对幅度的递减敏感性，类似于人类的价值函数；然而，模型对收益的情感强度显著高于等量损失，形成一种与经典损失厌恶相反的“硅基收益放大”现象。当结果并列比较时，情感评价呈现线性化趋势。在实际选择任务中，收益-损失不对称性基本消失，且模型自身的情感评分无法比金钱效用更有效地解释其决策行为。该研究揭示了从结果到情感的映射具有高度可塑性，从而引发对代理型大语言模型是否及如何整合预期情感进行决策的深层质疑。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40985
作者: Joseph Marks(1),Marius C. Vollberg(2 and 3) ((1) NatWest Group, London, UK, (2) University of Zurich, Zurich, Switzerland, (3) Swiss Center for Affective Sciences, Geneva, Switzerland)
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 64 pages (26 main text, 25 Supplementary Information, 13 GUIDE-LLM reporting checklist), 5 figures. Code: this https URL ; data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Good decisions often require considering how outcomes will feel. Yet large language models (LLMs) increasingly enter decision workflows, despite little being known about how they map outcomes to feelings or use those mappings in choice. We tested how LLMs anticipated gambling or stock-trading outcomes would feel and whether they incorporated these ratings into choice. When outcomes were rated in isolation, ratings exhibited diminishing sensitivity to magnitude, resembling human value functions; but models rated gains more intensely than equivalent losses, an inversion of canonical loss aversion we call silicon gain amplification. When outcomes were rated together, enabling direct comparison, ratings linearised. In choice, the gain-loss asymmetry largely disappeared, and models’ own ratings did not reliably explain their choices better than monetary utility did. These findings reveal malleable mappings from outcomes to affect, raising questions about whether and how agentic LLMs should incorporate anticipated feelings into decisions.

[NLP-61] Fewer Heads Fewer Memories: Pruning Redundant Attention Heads Suppresses Verbatim Memorisation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在推理过程中存在对训练数据中特定序列进行逐字复现（verbatim memorisation）的问题，这一现象引发了隐私泄露、知识产权暴露以及模型泛化能力受限的担忧。其解决方案的关键在于利用注意力头（attention head）的冗余性：通过在推理阶段剔除大量任务无关的冗余注意力头（task-redundant heads），可显著抑制模型对已记忆序列的复现行为，同时维持甚至提升语言建模性能。实验结果表明，在GPT-2-XL（1.5B）模型中移除729个冗余注意力头后，已知记忆序列的复现次数降低了91.5%，且在WikiText-103基准上的困惑度（perplexity）反而提升了0.92，证明了通过剪枝冗余注意力头即可在不重新训练或修改训练数据的前提下有效缓解记忆泄露问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40974
作者: Aryan Chowdhury,Riza Batista-Navarro
机构: University of Manchester(曼彻斯特大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 7 Pages, 5 Tables, 1 Figure

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models have been shown to memorise and reproduce verbatim sequences from their training data, raising concerns about privacy leakage, intellectual property exposure, and the limits of generalisation. Recent theoretical work suggests that attention heads may contribute to this behaviour by functioning as associative memory mechanisms, with memorisation capacity scaling with the number of heads. At the same time, empirical work has shown that many attention heads are redundant and can be pruned with limited impact on downstream performance. Despite these parallel findings, the effect of pruning redundant heads on memorised-sequence reproduction remains unexplored. In this work, we demonstrate that zeroing out a substantial fraction of attention heads prior to inference can significantly suppress verbatim memorisation while preserving, or even improving, language modelling performance on the benchmark used to identify redundant heads. Evaluating GPT-2-XL(1.5B) on known memorised sequences, we find that pruning 729 task-redundant heads reduces the memorisation count by 91.5%, while improving WikiText-103 perplexity by 0.92. These findings suggest that attention-head redundancy can be exploited to mitigate memorisation at inference time, without retraining or modifying the training data.

[NLP-62] Better Retrievers Worse Labels: How Incomplete Relevance Judgments Distort Abstention Evaluation in Conversational RAG

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前对话式检索增强生成（Conversational RAG）评估中普遍采用的“是否包含黄金文档”作为答案可回答性判断标准所导致的偏差问题。现有基准如MTRAG和RETECO通过端到端方式评估系统在自身检索结果上的生成能力，其默认假设是：若检索结果中不包含黄金文档（gold documents），则该上下文为不可回答。然而，该研究发现这一简化策略存在显著缺陷——即使没有黄金文档，许多上下文仍可能包含完整答案，主要来源于难负样本（hard negatives）、其他对话轮次的黄金内容或黄金页面邻近段落。研究通过重新运行官方基线，在RECOR（RETECO第二赛道）上使用四种检索器（nDCG@10从0.18到0.59）与三种Qwen3阅读器进行实验，并由两组开源大模型与四名小型开放模型组成的评审团对上下文内容进行标注，另由另一家族的模型盲审250个样本以确保一致性。结果显示，随着检索器性能提升，无黄金文档但实际包含答案的上下文比例从28%升至72%，而基于“有无黄金文档”的快捷判断方法的精确率从0.68降至0.10（审计后为0.70降至0.21）。此外，Qwen3-4B在这些“假阴性”样本中仍能正确回答62%–67%，远高于对被标记为“不足”上下文的响应率（23%–30%）及完全无文档情况下的响应率（1%）。因此，该研究的核心解决方案在于：不应将“是否有黄金文档”作为判断答案可回答性的依据，而应基于对上下文内容的实际语义分析进行评分，并建议未来评估应以内容标签而非黄金文档的存在与否来衡量系统的拒绝行为。研究还发现，最优的充分性检测器竟是一种不读取文档内容、仅依赖检索得分的模型，暗示当前评估体系对文档内容的理解能力可能存在根本性局限。研究已公开代码、实验结果与标注数据，推动更准确的评估范式。

作者: Ivan Kochergin,Vasily Konovalov
机构: Letovo School(列托沃学校); AXXX
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Conversational RAG benchmarks such as MTRAG and RETECO evaluate retrieval and generation end to end: each system answers from its own retrieval, so abstention must be scored against whether each retrieved context is sufficient. A convenient shortcut reads sufficiency off the relevance judgments and treats a context without gold documents as unanswerable. We re-run the official baselines exactly and test this shortcut on RECOR (RETECO track~2) with four retrievers (nDCG@10 from .18 to .59) and three Qwen3 readers. Two open LLM judges and a panel of four small open models label each context by content, and a model of another family audits 250 contexts blind, with adjudication. The stronger the retriever, the larger the share of no-gold contexts that still contain the answer (28% to 72%) and the lower the shortcut’s precision (.68 to .10; .70 to .21 under the audit). A reader agrees: Qwen3-4B answers 62–67% of these false misses correctly, against 23–30% of no-gold contexts judged insufficient and 1% with no documents. In most false misses, the answer comes from a hard negative mined for the same question, another turn’s gold or a neighbouring chunk of the gold page. On MTRAG, whose judgments come from annotators, precision drops from .72 to .50. Under the shortcut, answerability AUROC is up to .19 too low, and the best sufficiency detector appears to be a retrieval score that never reads the documents. We release code, runs and labels, and recommend scoring refusals against content labels, not the presence of gold.

[NLP-63] Kernel-based Interpolatory Methods for Context Compression of Attention Mechanisms

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现代语言模型中注意力机制（attention mechanisms）因上下文长度呈二次复杂度而带来的计算瓶颈问题，核心挑战在于如何高效压缩上下文信息，尤其是键值缓存（KV-cache）的存储与计算开销。其解决方案的关键在于将注意力机制在对应的核希尔伯特空间（Hilbert space associated with its kernel）中进行形式化建模，从而将注意力表示为两个线性映射之比，其插值可进一步分解为各自线性映射的插值。基于此理论框架，作者提出了两种新型的KV-cache压缩方法：基于广义经验插值法（GEIM）的GAIM和基于Q-离散经验插值法（Q-DEIM）的Q-DAIM。为降低计算复杂度，研究进一步引入基于泰勒展开、Performer及随机傅里叶特征（Random Fourier Features）的代理模型，使压缩过程可实现线性时间复杂度。此外，研究还扩展至流式注意力（streaming attention）场景，提出可依据历史插值信息动态调整插值节点选择并更新先前插值结果的新方法。数值实验表明，所提方法在残差收敛性与未来查询输出误差方面表现良好，并在LongBench-E基准上展现出与当前最优方法相当的性能，尤其验证了Q-DAIM方法能够有效揭示KV缓存中信息集中区域，从而支持更高效的压缩策略。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40943
作者: Michel Fabrice Serret,Laura Grigori
机构: Paul Scherrer Institute (保罗谢勒研究所); EPFL (瑞士联邦理工学院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Numerical Analysis (math.NA)
备注: 44 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The bottleneck of attention mechanisms, which are the fundamental building block of modern language models, is their quadratic complexity in terms of context size. There has thus been an increasing interest in the compression of the context, also called KV-cache compression. In this article, we consider the problem of compressing the context of attention mechanisms by first formulating it in the Hilbert space associated with its kernel. In this formalism, attention can be represented as the ratio of two linear maps whose interpolant is also the ratio of interpolants, this allows us to consider the interpolation of the linear maps directly. We thus introduce two novel KV-cache compression methods which we call GAIM and Q-DAIM, based on the Generalized Empirical Interpolation Method (GEIM) and the Q-Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (Q-DEIM), respectively. As the cost of these methods is quadratic in terms of context length, we propose surrogate models based on the Taylor series, the Performer and the Random Fourier Features method which allow the compression to be done in linear time. Finally, we extend this result to the streaming attention setting, providing new methods which allow one to penalize the selection of interpolation nodes based on the previously interpolated context and to update the previous interpolation based on new information. We then provide numerical results on the convergence of the residuals and the output error in future queries and preliminary results on the LongBench-E benchmark showing performance comparable to the state-of-the-art methods. These experiments suggest that the range revealed by our Q-DAIM method could help identify where information is concentrated in the KV cache, thus enabling an efficient compression.

[NLP-64] Adaptive Personalization Under Preference Epistemic Uncertainty

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话式人工智能在个性化响应中对动态变化的人类偏好适应能力不足的问题，尤其关注在认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）情境下如何实现自适应个性化。其核心挑战在于：现有语言模型虽能识别特定情境下的合适响应策略，但在开放生成过程中无法有效根据偏好不确定性调整策略，表现出“策略识别-生成”脱节现象，导致策略校准性能下降35%-46%。解决方案的关键在于通过监督模型内部策略表征，使其学习与当前状态条件相匹配的人类偏好模式，而非依赖静态偏好记忆。研究发现，仅靠提示工程无法缓解该问题，但经过针对性训练后，模型在跨分布人物角色和对话风格上的用户可接受性泛化能力显著提升，使通用性差距缩小约三分之一。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40930
作者: Priyanka Dey,Rajarshi Das,Vikas Bahirwani,Qi Zeng,Julia Kruk,Qi Qi
机构: Meta Superintelligence Labs (Meta); University of Southern California (南加州大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Human preferences change over time: an established preference may remain valid over time, become uncertain as context shifts, or be explicitly revised. Effective personalization requires conversational AI to adapt its response strategy to evolving preferences rather than relying on passive memory retrieval. We formalize this capability as adaptive personalization under epistemic uncertainty. A human preference study further confirms that people favor state-contingent response strategies as preference uncertainty changes. To evaluate whether language models mirror this adaptation, we create a multilingual benchmark spanning 250 personas, 5 languages, and 25K conversational turns that decouples strategy selection from response execution. Across eight closed- and open-weight models, we uncover a recognition-generation gap: models reliably identify appropriate strategies when selecting among candidate options, but collapse during open-ended generation, suffering a 35-46% drop in strategy calibration. Crucially, this failure is systematic: models default to exploit-first behavior, over-relying on existing preferences regardless of preference epistemic uncertainty. We show this failure is addressable: while prompting interventions fail, targeted training that supervises models’ internal strategy representations toward state-conditional human preferences narrows the user acceptability generalization gap by a third on out-of-distribution personas and conversational styles.

[NLP-65] CoFiBreak: A Coarse-to-Fine Diversity Reward for Effective Multi-Turn Jailbreak

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自动化红队测试（automated red teaming）中攻击多样性不足的问题。当前基于强化学习的攻击方法在仅以攻击成功率作为奖励时，容易导致攻击策略收敛于少数重复性提示，从而引发安全评估偏差，使测试集中于近似重复的攻击模式而非深层有害意图。现有方法通常需在攻击成功率、推理成本与内容/策略多样性之间进行权衡。本文提出一种粗粒度到细粒度的多样性奖励机制（CoFiBreak），集成于组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）框架中，通过双重奖励设计提升攻击多样性：粗粒度奖励鼓励各GRPO组内使用低频策略，增强策略层面的多样性；细粒度奖励则通过抑制去除有害意图信息后的提示嵌入中对同一角色设定、表述框架和输出格式的重复使用，扩展策略实现方式的多样性。该多样性奖励仅作用于已超过有效性阈值的攻击，确保多样性提升不依赖无效攻击，且所有奖励计算仅在训练阶段进行，保障推理效率。实验表明，在HarmBench上的前沿模型上，CoFiBreak发现的精细策略种类为最强基线的1.6–2.0倍；在AdvBench上达到98.8%的攻击成功率（ASR@10），且多样性得分高达最强攻击基线的2.1倍；所生成攻击可有效迁移至未见过的前沿大模型Claude-Opus-4.6，实现71.0%的ASR@10。核心解决方案在于通过分层多样性奖励机制，在不牺牲攻击效果和推理效率的前提下，显著提升攻击策略的广度与深度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40926
作者: Jialin Song,Xiaodong Liu,Weiwei Yang,Mingqian Feng,Chengquan Guo,Qiyao Ma,Carolyn Buractaon,Anson Ho,Wuyang Chen,Christopher White
机构: Simon Fraser University (西蒙菲莎大学); Microsoft Research (微软研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages main text, 24 pages total, 8 figures, 12 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated red teaming trains an attacker large language model (LLM) to elicit harmful responses from a victim LLM, but reinforcement learning can collapse attackers onto a narrow set of prompts when attack success is the only reward. Such a collapse of attack diversity can bias safety evaluation toward repeatedly testing near-duplicate attack patterns rather than the underlying harmful intents. Existing methods often trade off attack success or inference cost for greater content or strategy diversity. We propose CoFiBreak, a coarse-to-fine diversity reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that improves attack diversity while preserving strong attack effectiveness and low inference cost. The coarse reward broadens which strategies the attacker uses by encouraging strategies underrepresented within each GRPO group, while the fine reward broadens how those strategies are realized by discouraging reuse of the same personas, framings, and output formats after harmful-intent information is removed from prompt embeddings. Diversity rewards apply only to attacks that already exceed an effectiveness threshold, so diversity cannot be gained through ineffective attacks. Since both rewards are computed only during training, CoFiBreak also retains inference efficiency. Trained with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the victim, CoFiBreak discovers 1.6-2.0x as many distinct successful fine-grained strategies as the strongest baseline across frontier victims on HarmBench. It reaches 98.8% ASR@10 (attack success rate with 10 generations per intent) on AdvBench with the highest diversity score among all compared methods, which is 2.1x that of the strongest-attacking baseline. The resulting attacks transfer to unseen frontier LLMs, reaching 71.0% ASR@10 on AdvBench with the unseen victim Claude-Opus-4.6. The code will be released.

[NLP-66] Qistas: A Pre-Registered Portable Protocol for Fairness Evaluation of Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大型语言模型（LLM）公平性评估基准过度依赖英语及美国社会范畴所带来的文化偏见问题，尤其指出这些基准在跨语言、跨文化迁移时未能适配目标社会的现实语境，且缺乏对假设前提的预先校验。其核心解决方案是提出Qistas（阿拉伯语“公正的天平”），一种可跨国家移植的评估协议，首次应用于伊拉克社会语境，用于检验模型对社会、教派与区域群体的处理方式。该协议的关键在于构建基于匹配反事实对的程序对称性测量体系，涵盖差分拒绝行为、模糊情境下的刻板印象依赖、以及事件表述的术语框架，并通过成对分析方法（如符号翻转置换检验、精确麦内玛尔检验、模板聚类自举区间、霍尔姆校正多重比较）实现严格统计控制。此外，该协议包含预注册机制，明确各项假设、指标、排除规则与分析流程，并通过功率分析确定各维度在模板聚类设计效应下可检测的最小效应量。研究释放了完整的可复现作者工具包（包括修剪后的3×5分类体系、类型化检查清单、累积裁决日志、结构审计与人工审阅笔记），并在首个实地测试中发现24/25模板组至少存在一项缺陷，揭示出反事实公平性评估中普遍存在的风险：评估标准泄露至提示、阿拉伯语词形一致性的破坏、认知失衡的反事实对、单一主题拒答探针以及未明确定义的方言孪生体误计为覆盖范围。因此，本论文定位为协议开发而非结果报告，尚未评估任何模型，强调其方法论的可迁移性与严谨性。

Abstract:Fairness benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) are overwhelmingly English-born and American in their social categories; translated versions carry those categories into societies where they do not apply, and almost none fix their hypotheses before the models are run. We present Qistas (Arabic qistas, “the just balance”), a protocol for evaluating how LLMs treat the social, confessional, and regional constituencies of a society, portable across countries and instantiated first for Iraq. In its pilot form it measures only what needs no verdict on contested truth: procedural symmetry across matched counterfactual pairs, differential refusal, stereotype reliance under ambiguity, and terminological framing of documented events. Every measurement is paired by construction and analysed with paired machinery (sign-flip permutation tests, exact McNemar tests, template-clustered bootstrap intervals, Holm-corrected families), with a power analysis that states, before any data exist, the smallest effect each axis can detect after the design effect of template clustering. We release the authoring apparatus (a pruned 3x5 taxonomy with four cells closed by design, per-type checklists, a cumulative rulings log, a structural audit, and a human review notebook) and report its first field test: a semantic review of a 58-item seed bank in which 24 of 25 template groups failed at least one check. The defect patterns it exposed (evaluation criteria leaking into prompts, token-level swaps that break Arabic agreement, epistemically unbalanced pairs, single-theme refusal probes, unwritten dialect twins counted as coverage) are, we argue, general hazards of counterfactual fairness benchmarks. This is a protocol paper, not a results paper: no model has been evaluated, and the accompanying pre-registration commits the hypotheses, metrics, exclusion rules, and analysis plan that the pilot will follow.

[NLP-67] Incongruence-Aware Evaluation of Multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition in Audio Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语音交互式大语言模型在处理言语内容与语调情感时，文本与音频模态间不一致（incongruence）对语音情感识别性能的影响问题。其核心挑战在于：当文本语义与语音情感表达存在冲突时，这种不一致性是否会导致模型判断错误。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于双成分高斯混合模型的连续、无阈值的不一致评分机制，将文本与音频特征映射至共享的效价-唤醒度-主导性（valence-arousal-dominance, VAD）空间，并以二者之间的距离作为不一致程度的量化指标。通过与人工标注对比验证该评分的有效性，研究发现，在控制真实情感标签及特征空间距离后，不一致分数显著提升模型出错概率，且这一现象在多个数据集（eNTERFACE’05、MELD、CMU-MOSEI）中均成立。值得注意的是，尽管基于相同特征的监督分类器表现出相反趋势，表明问题根源并非信号本身，而在于模型融合原始证据的方式。此外，该不一致评分在去除情感词典依赖后仍能保持核心结论，且在六种简化替代方案中唯一能在所有三个数据集中稳定预测错误，凸显其鲁棒性与有效性。

作者: Fengji Jing,Guy Laban
机构: The University of Hong Kong (香港大学); Ben-Gurion University of the Negev (本·古里安大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multimedia (cs.MM); Sound (cs.SD); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Voice-interactive large language models process both what a speaker says and how they say it, yet the two channels do not always agree. We ask whether that disagreement degrades speech emotion recognition. Mapping text and audio into a shared valence-arousal-dominance space, we convert the distance between them into a continuous, threshold-free incongruence score with a two-component Gaussian mixture, and validate the score against human judgement. We evaluate three audiocapable models on acted, conversational and spontaneous speech (eNTERFACE’05, MELD and CMU-MOSEI). With the model held constant across modalities, incongruence raises the odds of error whenever audio is present, in every corpus, after controlling for the ground-truth emotion and for distance in the feature space. Supervised classifiers trained on the same features behave in the opposite way, which suggests that the difficulty lies in how these models combine raw evidence rather than in the signal itself. Text-only effects are unreliable: swapping only the model that reads the transcript reverses their sign on one corpus. Rebuilding the score without the emotion lexicon reproduces the central result, and among six simpler alternatives it is the only label-free score that predicts error in all three corpora. Code, data tables and prompts are released.

[NLP-68] FARO: Function-Space Adaptive Return-to-Risk Optimization via Cross-Block Equal-Risk-Contribution Budget Allocation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型训练中优化器参数更新策略依赖人工先验与固定全局更新预算所带来的局限性问题。现有方法通过手动划分不同层类型（如注意力模块与前馈网络）采用不同的优化几何（如正交化动量与Adam风格更新），这种设计不仅受限于人类对模型结构的直觉判断，且无法动态适应各参数块的实际学习表现。其核心解决方案是提出FARO（Function-space Adaptive Optimizer），以参数块（parameter block）为基本决策单元，基于每个块在反事实（counterfactual）下的实际收益自适应地分配优化几何，并引入来自投资组合理论的风险平价原则（Equal Risk Contribution, ERC），实现跨块的动态预算再分配。该方法通过冻结各块的更新路径并按风险贡献均衡重分配资源，避免了对特定层类型的预设几何。实验表明，在FineWeb数据集上训练的GPT类模型中，FARO-Adaptive臂在完整训练周期内达到3.2780 nats的损失，与最优人工设计策略NorMuonAndAdam（3.2794 nats）相当，无需人工设定每层优化器配置；而进一步引入ERC机制的FARO-ERC臂则在6个随机种子下均显著降低干净数据损失（平均下降0.0136 nats），统计检验（符号检验、配对t检验、置信区间）一致支持该改进，且未增加计算或内存开销。其优势在于通过裁剪高风险块而非扩展低风险块来优化整体性能，并在数据流污染条件下仍保持更低的平均损失及多数种子胜出，展现出鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40858
作者: Xiaojun Wu,Cehao Yang,Xuhui Jiang,Chengjin Xu,Jia Li,Jian Guo
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); IDEA Research; DataArcTech Ltd.
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 20 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Training a large language model is compute-bound, and current recipes divide the work between optimizers by hand: orthogonalized momentum for attention and MLP matrices, Adam-style updates for the rest. This division rests on human priors about which layer type deserves which geometry, and it fixes a single global update budget that every parameter block shares. We introduce FARO, a function-space adaptive optimizer that makes the partition of parameters into blocks the unit of decision. FARO gives each block a geometry by its realized counterfactual return, then freezes the routes and reallocates the frozen per-block budget by cross-block equal risk contribution (ERC), the risk-parity principle from portfolio theory. On a GPT-style model trained on FineWeb, the framework gives two results. First, its FARO-Adaptive arm reaches 3.2780 nats at the full schedule, matching NorMuonAndAdam (3.2794), the best hand-designed recipe: it recovers the human prior without hand-setting per-layer geometry. Second, FARO-ERC improves on that arm: it lowers the clean-data loss at every one of 6 seeds, by 0.0136 nats on average, a modest but robust gain. Its sign test, paired test, and confidence interval all agree, and it exceeds the measured run-to-run noise at no added time or memory. It works by trimming the riskiest blocks rather than expanding the safest, and it holds up under a corrupted stream, still lowering the mean loss and winning the seed majority. The source code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-69] he Generative Gap Between Speculative Drafter and Continuous Diffusion Language Model

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在无验证机制下的高效独立生成问题，具体聚焦于连续扩散语言模型（Continuous Diffusion Language Models, CDLMs）与推测性草稿生成器（speculative drafters）在独立生成场景下的性能差异。其核心挑战在于：尽管两类模型均能实现高效生成，但传统评估方式分别依赖于迭代精炼或目标模型验证，难以公平比较其内在生成能力。为此，研究提出在无验证、无目标特征的条件下对两类模型进行对比，采用LangFlow作为CDLM基准，并将DSpark的马尔可夫头与递归头架构改造为独立生成模式。所有模型均从零训练，基于相同预处理、骨干维度及训练预算，在16、128和1024长度上生成无条件单块OpenWebText数据。通过外部语言模型计算生成困惑度（GenPPL）与使用MAUVE衡量分布相似性进行评估。结果表明，在128和1024长度下，LangFlow显著优于两种DSpark变体；而在16长度下，DSpark-RNN表现更佳。进一步的条件KL分析揭示了马尔可夫头仅依赖前一词元所导致的依赖关系缺失，而递归记忆虽缓解此问题并提升性能，但长序列差距依然存在。此外，教师概率匹配可降低马尔可夫结构的GenPPL但未带来MAUVE提升；增加LangFlow的去噪步数在固定权重下有效改善短序列（16和128）性能，并改变其与DSpark-RNN的相对排序。综上，该研究确立了LangFlow在长序列生成中的优势，强调了迭代全序列精炼机制对于提升独立生成质量的关键作用，超越了仅依赖递归头记忆带来的改进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40847
作者: Yujian Chen,Hao Jiang,Guang Cheng,Weijian Luo,Tianyang Hu
机构: Polyadic Research Group; School of Computer Science, Peking University (北京大学计算机学院); SAGA Lab, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen (香港中文大学（深圳）SAGA 实验室); The University of California, Los Angeles (加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校); Dots Studio, Xiaohongshu (小红书点滴工作室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) and speculative drafters offer efficient language generation but are typically evaluated differently: CDLMs generate independently through iterative refinement, whereas drafters propose text for target-model verification and correction. We compare their architectures without verification, using LangFlow for CDLMs and adapting DSpark’s Markov and recurrent-head architectures for standalone generation. All models are trained from scratch for unconditional, single-block OpenWebText generation at lengths 16, 128, and 1024, without target features or verification, using common preprocessing, backbone dimensions, and training-update budgets. We evaluate generation perplexity (GenPPL) with an external language model and distributional similarity to reference text with MAUVE. With default denoising steps equal to sequence length, LangFlow outperforms both DSpark variants on both metrics at lengths 128 and 1024, while DSpark-RNN leads at 16. A conditional KL analysis characterizes dependencies excluded by the Markov head’s previous-token conditioning. Recurrent memory removes this restriction and improves both metrics, but the longer-sequence gap persists. Teacher probability matching further lowers Markov GenPPL without observed MAUVE gains. Increasing LangFlow’s denoising steps at fixed weights improves both metrics at lengths 16 and 128, changing the length-128 ordering relative to DSpark-RNN. These results establish LangFlow’s longer-sequence advantage under the evaluated budgets and highlight iterative full-sequence refinement as a route to improving standalone generation beyond gains from recurrent head memory.

[NLP-70] Safin-1.5: Safety-Native Architecture and Verifiable Reasoning for Recursive Safety Improvement

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在递归自提升（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI）过程中因持续迭代而引入新风险、削弱现有安全防护机制的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在不牺牲模型通用能力与实用性的情况下，实现安全性的持续增强。解决方案的关键在于提出“安全递归自提升”（Safety RSI）框架，通过三方面协同实现：首先，构建包含持久化安全状态与危险知识解耦的安全架构，使安全知识可被选择性调用，而高风险知识则被隔离至可移除的专家模块，从而实现安全强化的同时最小化对通用能力的影响；其次，建立发现-评估-修复的递归安全改进循环，基于实验反馈识别新漏洞并生成修复策略，仅采纳在提升安全性、维持通用能力及限制过度拒绝方面均表现优异的更新；最后，引入推理时形式化推理钩子（formal reasoning harness），结合语言理解与符号推理验证，通过证明义务引导的语义桥接恢复形式化表示中的缺失关系，使符号求解器能够在形式化前提和可接受的语义桥梁下构造可验证的证明。实验结果表明，Safin-1.5 在安全性和形式推理性能上均超越前沿模型，验证了该方法的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40751
作者: Jingnan Zheng,Cheng Jin,Ming Zhang,Huan Sun,Zhongtian Ma,Kaisen Yang,Ziyuan Zhou,Tong Wu,Dongcheng Zhang,Yi Zhang,Xiao Wang,Han Qi,Shu Yu,Ermo Hua,Zongji Yu,Chaozhuo Li,Xiaoyu Wen,Zhekai Chen,Jiawei Zhou,Sirui Chen,Ning Ding,An Zhang,Tat-Seng Chua,Xiangnan He,Xia Hu,Bowen Zhou,Qiaosheng Zhang,Youbang Sun,Xiang Wang,Zhongyu Huang,Chaochao Lu

类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables large language models to advance their capabilities through successive updates, but these updates can also introduce new risks and weaken existing safeguards. In line with the AI-45° Law, we pursue Safety RSI, in which safety develops as an intrinsic capability alongside general model capabilities through continual risk discovery and repair, while preserving utility and limiting over-refusal. We introduce Safin-1.5, a model built on a safety architecture and trained through recursive safety improvement, with an inference-time harness that extends its capabilities to formal reasoning. Our approach comprises three components: i) The safety architecture combines persistent safety states with hazardous-knowledge disentanglement. The former retains and selectively invokes safety knowledge, while the latter relocates targeted hazardous knowledge into removable experts, enabling its removal with minimal impact on general capabilities. ii) Recursive safety improvement establishes a discovery-evaluation-repair loop. The loop identifies new vulnerabilities and uses experimental feedback to develop repair strategies. It accepts updates only when they improve safety while preserving general capabilities and limiting over-refusal. iii) The formal reasoning harness combines the model’s language understanding with symbolic inference and verification. Proof-obligation-guided semantic bridging recovers missing relations in formal representations, enabling symbolic solvers to construct checkable proofs under formalized premises and accepted semantic bridges. Experimental results demonstrate that Safin-1.5 achieves safety and reasoning performance, outperforming frontier models.

[NLP-71] Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses MICRO

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有计算机使用代理（Computer-Use Agents, CUAs）在整合视觉图形用户界面（GUI）交互、代码执行与终端操作时缺乏统一策略的问题，尤其关注如何在保持高效推理成本的前提下实现多模态能力的协同。其核心解决方案是提出一种40亿参数的混合型CUA——Mage-VL-Cowork，通过一个端到端、分五阶段渐进式的训练课程（涵盖中段训练、监督微调和强化学习），从通用多模态对齐的检查点出发进行训练。关键创新在于构建了可扩展的“Mage-CUA-Forge”框架，将传统的任务定制化代理构建转变为可复用的技能条件生成工作流与应用特定预处理器，从而在6,915种技能下合成293,806个桌面与网页任务，使每任务重复开销降低82.6%。此外，不采用直接蒸馏默认教师模型的方式，而是动态演化教师代理框架，并引入专用的CUA代理框架以生成高质量轨迹并提供阶段特异性监督信号，显著提升了训练效率与最终性能。最终，Mage-VL-Cowork-4B在OSWorld-Verified基准上达到66.0%的准确率，在同规模模型中处于领先水平，推动了本地化智能（on-device intelligence）的发展边界。

机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. Mage-VL-Cowork-4B finally climbs to 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified through different training stages with more efficient reasoning cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance at its parameter size and pushing forward the frontier of on-device intelligence.

[NLP-72] Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech Reasoning and Tool Use

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有语音助手在理解用户请求、上下文推理、多轮对话维持以及通过工具执行任务等方面的局限性，尤其针对传统系统中语音处理与语言理解模块分离导致的延迟高、协同能力弱的问题。其核心解决方案是提出一个统一的开源语音-语言模型Apriel Voice 27B Preview，该模型基于预训练的Gemma 4 26B-A4B检查点构建，具备共享的推理主干（reasoning backbone），可直接接收语音输入并生成文本响应与工具调用，无需依赖独立的对话模型。关键创新在于采用两阶段训练机制：第一阶段建立语音接口，第二阶段通过监督微调、文本重播及源相关交叉熵与前向Kullback–Leibler散度联合监督，实现投影器与主干网络的协同优化；同时利用自动生成的语音条件对话数据进行对话训练，并结合本地教师服务、计算重叠与融合全词汇损失实现高效的在线知识蒸馏。实验表明，该模型在Big Bench Audio（98.90分）、Speech-BFCL（81.13分）和τ-Voice任务成功率（65.51%）等指标上表现优异，平均延迟仅1.91秒，且在英语EVA准确率（51.27%）和经验通过率pass@1（74.13%）方面亦有显著提升，最终部署于定制化服务平台以支持实时交互式语音交互。

Abstract:A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a separate dialogue model. We introduce a two-stage training procedure to adapt the model to speech. The first stage establishes the speech interface, while the second jointly adapts the projector and backbone through supervised fine-tuning, text replay, and source-dependent cross-entropy and forward Kullback–Leibler divergence supervision. Automatically constructed speech-conditioned dialogues provide conversational training data, while local teacher serving, overlapping teacher and student computation, and fused full-vocabulary losses enable efficient online distillation. In thinking mode, Apriel Voice achieves a score of 98.90 on Big Bench Audio, 81.13 on Speech-BFCL, and a task success rate of 65.51% on \tau -Voice, with a mean latency of 1.91 seconds. It also achieves 51.27% English EVA accuracy and 74.13% experience pass@1. Finally, we deploy Apriel Voice 27B Preview on a custom serving platform to support interactive voice interactions.

[NLP-73] Li2SAO: Lifting Light Singl-Rollout Asynchronous RL Optimization via Group-Relative Actor-Critic Bootstrapping

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决异步强化学习（Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning, ARL）在大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）后训练中因采样策略与训练动态不匹配而导致的稳定性与离策略行为不佳的问题，尤其针对代理型任务（agentic tasks）表现欠佳的瓶颈。现有方法如单轮次异步优化（Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization, SAO）虽提升了性能，但依赖于闭源的预训练价值模型（value model），限制了其可复现性与泛化能力。为此，本文分析了组内采样策略（Group-wise Sampling, GRPO）与轻量级复现版本LiSAO在单轮推理与多轮代理任务上的表现差异，发现GRPO在推理任务上更优，而LiSAO在代理任务上更具潜力，但受限于未充分训练的价值函数导致早期性能滞后。为突破此局限，本文提出Li² SAO，其核心创新在于引入“组相对演员-评论家自举”（group-relative actor-critic bootstrapping）机制：在评论家尚处于冷启动阶段时，通过组相对优势（group-relative advantage）指导演员（actor）更新，并以组中心回报（group-centered return）引导评论家初始化，待模型收敛后再切换至单轮次广义优势估计（GAE）。实验表明，Li² SAO不仅在早期训练阶段快速追赶并超越GRPO，且显著提升后期性能上限，实现了高效、稳定且无需依赖外部预训练价值模型的异步训练方案。

Abstract:Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming a mainstream paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs), as it improves training efficiency by updating the model as rollouts arrive. Recent work argues that group-wise sampling in GRPO does not naturally fit asynchronous RL training because rollout lengths follow a long-tailed distribution, and proposes Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) to improve stability and off-policy behavior, especially on agentic tasks. However, SAO relies on a closed-source value model obtained from scaling value pretraining. In this paper, we analyze GRPO and LiSAO, our lightweight reproduction of SAO without the pretrained value model, on single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic tasks. We find that GRPO outperforms LiSAO on reasoning tasks, while the reverse holds on agentic tasks. Since the value model of LiSAO is not yet well trained , LiSAO lags behind GRPO substantially in early training steps. To address this issue, we propose Li ^2 SAO, which Lifts Light Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization with group-relative actor-critic bootstrapping: while the critic is cold, a group-relative advantage trains the actor and a group-centered return trains the critic, after which training switches to single-rollout GAE. Experiments show that Li ^2 SAO catches up with or surpasses GRPO in early training and further raises the later performance ceiling. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-74] Leaner Training Lower Leakage: Revisiting Memorization in LLM Fine-Tuning with LoRA

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在微调阶段，尤其是针对参数高效微调方法LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）时的过拟合记忆（memorization）问题，这一现象可能导致数据提取攻击（data extraction attacks）。尽管预训练阶段的过拟合记忆已受到广泛研究，但其在微调阶段的表现，特别是LoRA微调中的影响仍缺乏系统探讨。论文的关键发现是：与传统全量微调或预训练阶段不同，模型规模和数据重复性等关键因素在LoRA微调中对记忆行为的影响呈现显著差异，表现出非预期的弱相关性。其解决方案的核心在于引入一种更宽松的基于相似性的记忆度量方式，证明了相较于全量微调，LoRA在显著降低记忆风险的同时，仍能保持优异的任务性能，从而为参数高效微调的安全性提供了新的理论支持与实践依据。

Abstract:Memorization in large language models (LLMs) makes them vulnerable to data extraction attacks. While pre-training memorization has been extensively studied, fewer works have explored its impact in fine-tuning, particularly for LoRA fine-tuning, a widely adopted parameter-efficient method. In this work, we re-examine memorization in fine-tuning and uncover a surprising divergence from prior findings across different fine-tuning strategies. Factors such as model scale and data duplication, which strongly influence memorization in pre-training and full fine-tuning, do not follow the same trend in LoRA fine-tuning. Using a more relaxed similarity-based memorization metric, we demonstrate that LoRA significantly reduces memorization risks compared to full fine-tuning, while still maintaining strong task performance. [NLP-75] Agent ic Systems for Calibrating Cosmological Simulations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决宇宙学模拟校准这一高维、计算成本高昂的参数优化问题。传统方法如贝叶斯优化虽能实现自动化，但将模拟器视为黑箱，难以融入人类领域知识或科研工作流程。为此，本文提出AgenticTuner，一种基于当代大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）作为智能体（agent）的校准流水线，由该智能体主动提出下一组参数试验。关键创新在于：通过引入非正式的人类可读先验信息（如代码库、文档和经验性指导原则），大语言模型能够以极低的CPU开销实现与传统方法相当甚至更优的校准性能。该方案的核心在于将人类科学家的经验知识编码为自然语言形式的上下文输入，使生成式智能体在参数探索中具备更强的科学合理性与效率，从而推动迈向能够执行复杂、长周期科学任务的AI科学家。

作者: Chaipat Tirapongprasert,Matthew Ho

类目: Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics (astro-ph.IM); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to the 9th annual workshop for Machine Learning the Physical Sciences (ML4PS). A starter code is available on this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Calibrating a cosmological simulation is an expensive, high-dimensional parameter optimization task. Previous works employ Bayesian optimization for automation, which treats the simulator as a black box and precludes the incorporation of human domain knowledge or workflow into the selection policy. We propose AgenticTuner, an agentic calibration pipeline with a present-day large language model serving as the optimizer who proposes the next parameter trial. We show that these agents can achieve competitive calibration performance at a fraction of the CPU cost when they are given informal, human-readable priors (such as codebase, documentation, and heuristic guides that seasoned scientists may possess). We hope this work serves as an early step toward AI scientists that can carry out complex, long-horizon scientific tasks.

[IR-0] Recommendation Feedback Loops Shape Urban Income Segregation and Venue Visitation RECSYS

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41911
作者: Guangyuan Weng,Lin Chen,Ciro Beneduce,Giovanni Mauro,Massimiliano Luca,Takahiro Yabe,Bruno Lepri,Luca Pappalardo,Esteban Moro
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI); Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph)
备注: 13 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Location-based recommender systems shape where people go in cities and learn from the visits they steer, forming a human-AI feedback loop. This feedback loop shapes whom people share places with across income groups and which venues keep attracting customers. Yet platforms judge these systems by their offline accuracy on past visits, a test in which the suggestions never change where people go and which therefore cannot capture long-term effects. Studying these effects in cities is challenging because, unlike online resources, travel constraints and limited venue capacity shape where people can go, while each recommended visit also changes whom other visitors encounter. To capture such features, we build a long-term simulation framework based on fine-grained human mobility data from four U.S. metropolitan areas, with distance and capacity constraints. Focusing on food venues, we study two urban consequences: how unevenly people’s exposure is distributed across income groups (experienced income segregation) and the share of venues receiving no visits from simulated residents (venue disappearance). We find that, under every algorithm and in every metropolitan area, at least a fifth of venues stop receiving visits, and that more than half of this loss arises from retraining. More importantly, more accurate algorithms leave people more segregated, and the most accurate algorithm leaves people 15-21% more segregated than they actually are. We then test a re-ranking intervention that favours less popular venues and runs on top of a platform’s existing algorithm. It lowers both venue disappearance and segregation across algorithms, largely without directing people to venues where they may feel less comfortable. Our results suggest that impact assessments of recommender systems should account for the feedback loop and report segregation and venue disappearance beyond accuracy.

[IR-1] Completeness and Cost of Retrieval Structures for Multi-Tool Requests in LLM Agents

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41905
作者: Shuyang Zhang
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 17 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:An agent that must call several tools to fulfill a request fails when the tool retriever omits any one of them, yet tool retrievers are mostly built and evaluated on queries requiring a single tool. We compare representatives of six retrieval structures (flat lexical and dense retrieval, LLM query decomposition, LLM-navigated hierarchies, server-then-tool matching, dependency graphs, and trained set-level retrievers) across two multi-tool testbeds: 345 AppWorld queries with expert dependency labels and 103 MCP-Bench tasks over 257 MCP tools. We measure completeness@k, the share of queries whose entire required tool set appears in the top k, alongside the LLM calls, tokens, and latency that each structure incurs at retrieval time. A motivating analysis on all 7,961 ToolRet queries shows that aggregate completeness mixes two regimes: completeness at 10 is .58 to .67 on single-target queries and .08 to .17 on queries with four or more targets, and the ordering of retrievers on single-target queries reverses on multi-target ones. Across the two testbeds, none of the compared structures that is untrained on the testbed and makes at most one LLM call per query completes more than 10% of AppWorld queries at k = 16. The two structures that do better incur different costs: a set-level retriever trained on 75 to 90 in-domain queries reaches .33 on AppWorld and .58 on MCP-Bench with no LLM calls, while an LLM-navigated hierarchy reaches .30 and .40 with a median of 31 to 38 LLM calls and about five minutes per query. Their failure modes also differ: the trained retriever mostly ranks the missing tools just below the cutoff, whereas the hierarchy finds the target API and stops before collecting its prerequisites. In a downstream check with the official AppWorld agent, tasks with a complete retrieved set succeeded 21 of 21 times, whereas incomplete ones succeeded 2 of 39 times.

[IR-2] Peeling the Matryoshka: Extracting Ontological Structure from Retrieval Embeddings EMNLP2026

作者: Eunchan Kim,Inwhee Joe
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 13 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Taxonomy construction is essential for knowledge-intensive NLP yet remains costly: clustering-based methods (i) need careful per-corpus tuning and yield unstable hierarchies, while LLM-based pipelines (ii) depend on expensive task-specific training that does not transfer across domains. We report an empirical finding that bears on both: in Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) embeddings, where each leading prefix is itself a usable, coarser vector, prefix length aligns with the coarse-to-fine granularity of gold taxonomies; shuffled- and reverse-dimension controls isolate the alignment to the learned early prefix dimensions. The pattern holds across three architecturally distinct MRL models. To test whether this regularity is usable, we introduce PEEL (Peeling Embeddings to Extract Latent ontologies): a minimal probe over these frozen embeddings, trained once with an order-embedding objective that represents hierarchy as vector containment; a minimum spanning arborescence then decodes taxonomic DAGs. Using only a concept vocabulary (no documents), PEEL recovers taxonomic DAGs with high structural fidelity on two OLLM benchmarks, transferring to a new domain with no target-edge supervision. The end-to-end OLLM pipeline, which jointly discovers concepts and induces structure from document corpora, is reported as a cross-task reference. Pre-trained retrieval embeddings encode a decodable granularity gradient; a minimal probe renders it as explicit parent-child (is-a) structure.

[IR-3] Search When Needed Proceed When Reliable: Metacognitive Reliability Supervision for Efficient Agent ic Search

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41738
作者: Minhao Sun,Zhijing Wu,Xian-Ling Mao
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Efficient agentic search requires large language models (LLMs) to determine whether they can reliably proceed with their current knowledge or need additional external evidence. Supervision based on final-answer correctness or trajectory-level feedback evaluates realized trajectory performance. However, observed trajectory performance is jointly shaped by stochastic generation, retrieval quality, and downstream reasoning. Such signals therefore provide only indirect evidence of how reliable the current decision state was and how retrieved evidence changed its reliability. An effective reward should encourage search when external information is needed and favor searches that contribute to the answer. To this end, we propose a metacognitive framework for training LLMs to make search decisions based on the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states. Our framework estimates the reliability of local conclusions to distinguish whether the current information supports proceeding without search from how much retrieved evidence improves that reliability. The current-state reliability score assesses whether the model can proceed without search. The search-action score measures how retrieved evidence changes estimated reliability. Together, these scores define a reliability-aware process reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), providing finer-grained supervision for search and no-search behavior. Experiments across seven question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than strong agentic-search baselines. Our code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced.

Abstract:Recommender system (RS) nowadays has to reflect, combine, and solve often contrasting requirements and expectations from dozens of stakeholders. In fact, the problem is even more complicated as each of the stakeholders can simultaneously have various objectives creating a diverse and complicated environment with several stakeholders and their objectives in which a RS operates. To address this problems the Multi-objective and Multi-stakeholder RS have been studied in the literature. However, a limited attention has been paid to trustworthiness aspects of such RS, which slowly becomes a new standard. In this paper, we highlight open challenges and important questions which need to be addressed on the way to trustworthy Multi-stakeholder RS.

Abstract:This study investigates the effectiveness of large pre-trained language models (LLMs) for knowledge entity relation extraction (KERE) from academic papers. Existing studies have examined individual types of LLM-based strategies and evaluated model performance using metrics such as precision and recall. To provide a broader evaluation, this study investigates multiple strategies, including closed-source LLM-based CoT prompting, LoRA-adapted open-source LLMs, LLM-enhanced small pre-trained language models (SLMs), and SLM-enhanced closed-source LLMs. In addition, this study introduces two strategies, namely SLM-enhanced open-source LLMs and closed-source LLM-enhanced open-source LLMs. These strategies are evaluated from multiple perspectives, including metrics, their ability to mitigate errors observed in SLMs, and potential directions for model optimization. This study manually constructs two annotated datasets in the NLP domain, covering Abstract and Full-Text datasets. Experimental results show that the LoRA-adapted T5 model achieves the highest macro F1 scores of 0.7408 and 0.7013 on the Abstract and Full-Text datasets, respectively. SLMs also benefit from LLM-generated entity descriptions under the LLM-enhanced SLM strategy. Error analysis further reveals that the effectiveness of LLM-based strategies in mitigating SLM errors varies across error types. Based on the identified limitations and error patterns of these strategies, several optimization directions are proposed. In addition, combining strategies with different error patterns further improves KERE performance.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many long-term memory systems for LLM agents are built around embedding-based retrieval. Al- though effective for semantic matching, similarity ranking alone does not establish whether re- trieved memories satisfy the conditions implied by a question. In this paper, we introduce KITE (Knowledge-Indexed Temporal Evidence), a vector-free framework that formulates memory re- trieval as an explicit decision procedure. KITE organizes multi-session conversations as structured knowledge indexed by a governed topic vocabulary, which evolves through controlled expansion and consolidation. At query time, questions are compiled into inspectable retrieval plans over the same knowledge index that guides memory construction. The plans are then executed through fixed lookup and ranking operations, while sparse lexical retrieval recovers surface details omitted from the structured representation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that KITE achieves 93.5% and 86.0% accuracy while using only about 1.6k reader-context tokens per ques- tion. These results demonstrate that conversational memory can move beyond similarity ranking by unifying memory construction and query compilation around a governed index, turning retrieval into an inspectable decision procedure for determining which evidence satisfies the question.

作者: Mathias Vast,Basile Van Cooten,Laure Soulier,Benjamin Piwowarski

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cross-encoders are the most effective but also the least efficient models in Information Retrieval. Despite their success, the mechanisms underlying their relevance predictions remain poorly understood, particularly how they process to match queries and documents. This lack of interpretability limits their optimization, can lead to suboptimal retrieval, especially out-of-domain, and raises efficiency concerns for over-parameterized models. To address these challenges, this paper investigates two under-explored aspects of cross-encoder behavior. First, to understand the relevance prediction process, we trace the flow of information at the different stages of the process and between different input segments. We study the nature of the signals that compose this flow and that allow cross-encoders to predict the relevance of a passage to a query. Our work particularly focuses on the matching performed by the cross-encoders between queries and documents. Second, we explore how cross-encoders behave with out-of-domain documents and/or queries. Through a series of interpretability experiments, we evaluate three BERT-based cross-encoder models, varying in size and pre-training strategies, across both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets. Overall, this study both consolidates what is known about how cross-encoders model relevance and extends it by exploring the role of matching signals.

[IR-8] Fidelity Synopses: Pre-Execution Plan Selection for Approximate Vector Search

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41407
作者: Adithya Ramanatha,Sanskar S. Singh,Maya Ramanath
类目: Databases (cs.DB); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vector search has become a database operator with many physical implementations: different index families, build-time and search-time parameters, and compressed or disk-resident variants. Each trades cost against fidelity, the fraction of a query’s exact top-k nearest neighbors that a configuration returns. Deployments nevertheless choose one configuration offline and use it for every query, so they are sized for their hardest queries and overpay for the rest. On a 5.8M-item LAION benchmark with four embedding models, running each query on the cheapest configuration that suffices for it would roughly halve the cost in a typical setting. Exploiting this requires predicting each configuration’s fidelity before running it, which is hard because fidelity is defined by the very exact search that approximate indexes avoid. Relational optimizers solve the analogous problem for cardinality with offline synopses; we propose one for vector search. A fidelity synopsis divides the embedding space into cells around a set of landmarks and records, for every cell and configuration, how often that configuration met a fidelity target on a sample of queries. At query time, one nearest-landmark lookup yields a calibrated estimate for every configuration, and an optimizer chooses configurations so that the workload misses the target no more often than its requirement allows. We test the two premises the synopsis relies on, that fidelity varies smoothly across the embedding space and that its loss is specific to each configuration. Held to the same requirement a static deployment is built to meet, synopsis-guided selection lowers cost in all 16 combinations of model and query direction, to a median of 0.72x the static deployment, with a batched lookup of 21-32 microseconds per query. The saving persists against the best static choice among the same indexes, and within a single index at no extra memory.

Abstract:In AI for Science scenarios, experimental design and method reproduction require retrieving protocols that satisfy multiple interdependent constraints, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of this capability. To address this gap, we introduce ProSearch, a benchmark for multi-constraint protocol retrieval in experimental science. ProSearch has three key features: (1) realism, with queries grounded in real experimental records and expert-defined templates; (2) complexity, with 60 experimental fields and their dependencies; and (3) diagnosticity, with 3-5 explicit constraints per query, including numerical and negation constraints. We construct ProSearch through LLM-based extraction, data-driven constraint selection, controlled query generation, and evidence-based relevance validation. The resulting benchmark contains 1,515 queries across six experimental science domains. We conduct extensive experiments on ProSearch with 19 representative retrievers and complementary analyses. The best-performing retriever achieves an average nDCG@10 of only 0.290, which improves to 0.474 with reranking. Structured diagnostic analysis shows that explicit constraint matching provides a strong ranking signal, while manual error analysis identifies joint constraint binding as a key bottleneck. ProSearch provides a testbed for systematically evaluating scientific retrieval systems.

Abstract:User simulation aims to reproduce how users interact with content and products across online platforms. Recent generative approaches have enriched user simulation with behavioral history and contextual information. However, realistic browsing simulation still faces two challenges. (i) Stochastic Responses: Even with the same recommendation feed, the same user may produce different browsing responses, yielding distinct behavioral trajectories. A logged trajectory records only one such realization. (ii) Sparse Key Events: Clicks and likes provide important feedback but occur sparsely within browsing trajectories dominated by progression actions such as scrolling. For Sparse Key Events, BrowseFlow represents each response by its browsing extent and an ordered sequence of key events, directly modeling their counts and locations under exposure constraints. BrowseFlow learns the conditional distribution of complete browsing responses through probabilistic extent prediction and discrete flow matching over key events. Random event retention defines probability paths over partial event sequences, while transition rate matching learns stochastic insertion dynamics. For Stochastic Responses, we use the energy score, a proper scoring rule, to evaluate response fidelity and generated variability, complemented by the Wasserstein distance between key event count distributions. We further introduce TaobaoBrowse, a benchmark pairing real recommendation contexts with fine-grained browsing trajectories. Experiments across three datasets demonstrate that BrowseFlow consistently achieves the best distributional performance.

Abstract:In modern information retrieval (IR), documents are increasingly encountered as structured sequences of visually rich, paginated units, rather than as flat text. Example documents encountered in our daily life include Word files, PDFs, and slide decks. In this paper, we formulate page-centric Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) with pages as the fundamental indexing units and document context available for assessing page relevance. The formulation distinguishes two retrieval granularities, page and document, and three retrieval paradigms: independent-item, evidence-set, and iterative retrieval. We then assess 42 benchmarks using eight criteria covering corpus characteristics, query construction, relevance annotation, and ranking support. Our analysis shows two main findings on current VDR research. First, evaluation remains concentrated on page-level independent-item retrieval, with fewer resources supporting document-level, evidence-set, and iterative settings. Second, queries originating from real user information needs independently of target corpus content and graded relevance judgments are uncommon, while the coverage and verification of relevance judgments vary substantially. Both findings reveal gaps between the capabilities applications require and those existing evaluation protocols can establish. We provide benchmark selection guidance and identify priorities for future benchmark design, emphasizing alignment between task requirements, relevance semantics, and evaluation protocols.

Abstract:Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop. It exposes a context problem: an undisciplined loop repeats queries, rereads documents, and fills the window with unused passages. The missing layer is knowledge compilation: a configurable ingestion pipeline where LLMs enrich documents with context no chunk contains alone–navigation hierarchies with claim-evidence leaves, entity graphs, timelines, mind maps, ontologies, wikis, and memory. A decision gate cuts latency from 140 s to 30 s, though substitution’s token saving is bought with retrieval rounds and carries its own latency cost. Abstract:A focused crawler searches for web pages on a specific topic under a constrained download budget. Our results show that text classifiers and keyword matching do not significantly outperform breadth-first crawling, whereas neural embeddings, which compare link texts by semantic meaning, outperform all simple strategies. Abstract:Recommendation unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific historical interactions that should no longer affect future recommendations, such as noisy clicks or outdated user preferences. However, performing recommendation unlearning becomes much harder in modern Machine-Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS) architectures, where the recommendation model is remotely hosted by a model provider (MP) and accessed by service operators (SO) only through APIs. In this setting, a service operator serves end users but cannot access or modify internal model parameters. As a result, existing unlearning methods are difficult to apply because they require access to model internals for retraining, fine-tuning, or other parameter updates. To address these challenges, we propose Causal Explanation-based Unlearning (CEU), a novel unlearning framework tailored for MLaaS environments. Instead of modifying internal model weights, CEU operates through a two-step output-level score intervention. First, it estimates how the forgotten interaction causally contributes to the current recommendation. Second, guided by this causal signal, the system removes the influence of the forgotten interaction by adjusting the final ranking scores of affected items. Because CEU leaves model parameters untouched, it naturally supports continuous unlearning requests while avoiding the error accumulation that can result from repeated parameter updates. Extensive experiments on three public datasets show that CEU achieves unlearning effectiveness comparable to full retraining while preserving recommendation utility and significantly reducing computational cost. Abstract:As generative artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more capable and widely used, understanding when and how humans should work with these systems is becoming increasingly important. However, the empirical evidence in this space offers conflicting recommendations, which leaves individuals and organizations without clear guidance on when to combine human and AI capabilities. Existing meta-analyses can help reconcile these findings, but they require substantial manual effort and cannot readily incorporate new evidence as it emerges. To address this challenge, we introduce AutoAnalysis: an automated, self-updating meta-analysis of when humans and AI work better together, and when they work better alone. Across this body of work, we found that, on average, human-AI combinations performed significantly better than humans alone, but they performed significantly worse than the better of humans or AI alone. These findings highlight the important distinction between improving human performance and achieving human-AI synergy and underscore the need to evaluate collaboration against both human and AI performance alone. As new studies emerge, AutoAnalysis will integrate their findings into the meta-analysis, providing cumulative evidence about when humans and AI perform better together and how human-AI performance varies across AI agents, tasks, and processes.

Abstract:Architectural spaces are increasingly gaining robotic capabilities. Architectural robots such as robotic partitions, ceilings, furniture, facades, and other spatial components can autonomously move and reconfigure in response to occupants’ needs and activities. Yet, when architectural robots start shaping the spatial conditions in which people continuously live, work, and interact, we may begin to experience the architectural space itself as robotic. What does this shift mean for how we inhabit such spaces? Drawing on our previous studies, I reflect on how architectural robots interact with people not only through their motions, but also through the spatial configurations that persist after those motions stop; how their actions may benefit some occupants while disadvantaging others; and how multiple robots may together make a whole architectural space appear to act. I argue that as computation gains the capacity to physically reconfigure our environments, interaction extends beyond the moment of computational action into the spatial conditions that people continue to inhabit. Understanding robotic architecture therefore requires us to look beyond short-term human-robot interaction and toward how people inhabit, negotiate, and maintain control over spaces that can autonomously reconfigure.

Abstract:Pathological tremor is the most prevalent movement disorder worldwide, characterized by involuntary muscular oscillations within a frequency of 3 to 12 Hz. Abstract:Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients’ health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.

Abstract:Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Our designed AX tools return compact observations, execute actions in batches, and report their effects as AX diffs, so the model needs fewer round trips. Abstract:Long-context interaction and persistent memory allow LLM assistants to develop history-grounded understandings of users. Abstract:Image-based dietary assessment can automate initial food logging, but meal photographs often leave food identity, hidden ingredients, preparation, and portion uncertain, making correction a recurring part of use. Abstract:Long-term, diverse personal informatics data enables athletes to understand and act on their health and performance goals, whether assessing readiness right now, tracking how soreness relates to training load over time, or predicting how sleep affects next-day performance. Our findings offer a practical, goal-conditioned framework that guides researchers in selecting imputation strategies aligned with both the underlying missingness mechanism and the specific analytical goal of long-term self-tracking studies.

作者: Hanzhao Wang,Shengjie Liu,Zhengchao Wang

Abstract:AI agents increasingly carry out delegated tasks in parallel, with one person overseeing several of them at once. In practice, an agent often lacks information its task requires, such as an unstated preference, constraint, or specification. It can ask the human to clarify, or it can search for the information itself, for example in past records, which takes time and effort and may fail. In this paper, we study how to coordinate these decisions across several agents that share one human with limited attention. We build a stylized model in which each agent can search, ask, or continue the parts of its task that do not depend on the missing information, and we formulate the problem as a dynamic program. We first show that whether an agent should ask depends on more than its own uncertainty: an agent with other work to do can be better off asking earlier, and which question the human should answer first depends on all waiting questions, so no ranking computed agent by agent is optimal. We then propose the Pairwise Coordination Policy (PCP), which uses exact one- and two-task problems to estimate how pairs of tasks delay each other when they share the human. Theoretically, PCP is exactly optimal when at most two requirements remain unresolved and costs at most twice the optimum when every unresolved requirement must be resolved by the human. We evaluate PCP on 864 synthetic cases and in a case study with LLM agents. On the synthetic benchmark, PCP’s mean gap to optimal cost is 0.07%, and it reduces cost by an average of 18-31% relative to three standard rules for when to ask. In the LLM case study, agents completed every task correctly, and PCP achieved the lowest mean cost in all tested settings.

We propose Flash Word, a subtitling system which generates and presents shortened intralingual subtitles for English audio by detecting keywords from the script. Flash Word extracts keywords from scripts using an existing algorithm, and shows them one at a time like a flashcard. Flash Word aims to enable ESL students to focus better on listening by minimising the cost of reading subtitles.

Abstract:As agentic AI in education shifts from reactive tools toward partners that take initiative and persist over time, a central question is how learners relate to, evaluate, and benefit from artificial agency. The agent decided when to intervene through a trigger-based architecture, and its social role was manipulated between teams: a Cognitive Agent that challenged quick consensus or a Supportive Agent that invited quieter members to contribute. Combining chat discourse, post-session surveys, and spoken reflections, we identified distinct patterns unfolding across three timescales. Students accommodated their language to the agent’s role immediately, using more social language toward the Supportive Agent from the first session. A slower crossover emerged in perceived collaboration process and positive-affect word use in reflections: Supportive-Agent teams began below Cognitive-Agent teams and ended above them, although students rated the Supportive Agent less helpful throughout. Because these responses follow different trajectories, single-session evaluations of agentic AI may miss changes that emerge only through repeated interaction.

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for informal mental health support, yet the privacy implications of conversational interaction remain poorly understood. We introduce a profile-recovery framework that measures personal information exposure by comparing user profiles with attributes inferred from conversation alone. We generate 240 synthetic multi-turn mental health conversations from profiles sampled from a nationally representative health survey and validate them against real counseling transcripts, finding comparable overall disclosure volume. Across 21 attributes, 33-41% of each profile is recoverable, with 76.5% first-inference and 94.3% any-of-3 accuracy. 239 of 240 conversations expose at least one sensitive mental health attribute, and 45.0% expose all six. Our findings reveal a gap between disclosure and inferability, motivating HCI approaches to make inference risks legible and support privacy-aware interaction design.

Abstract:Generative audio systems can produce large libraries of personalized bedtime content, but ordinary media objectives (retention, completion, and novelty) are poorly aligned with the goal of supporting a transition toward sleep. Abstract:Autonomous delivery robots increasingly share residential spaces with companion animals, yet navigation behavior is rarely designed with animal welfare in mind. Following a research through design approach, we developed and evaluated a first design iteration of the artifact in a naturalistic home environment with a companion dog. Contrary to our hypothesis, the curve-out produced a more acute stress response than the straight-line baseline. Abstract:Augmented reality (AR) can support vocabulary learning by placing mnemonic cues in the physical contexts where new words are encountered. [CV-0] SemEllipsoid: Semantic-aware Shape Abstraction with Ellipsoid

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.42145
作者: Kuankuan Cheng,Haocheng Yuan,Changjian Li
类目: Graphics (cs.GR); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Representing 3D shapes using a set of primitives - known as shape abstraction - is an actively studied problem in computer graphics with wide applications in shape understanding, analysis, and simulation due to the compactness and computational efficiency of the primitive-based representation. Prior work has primarily focused on geometry-aware shape abstraction, where the objective is to approximate the input shape with a minimal set of primitives while preserving geometric fidelity. However, these methods often overlook semantic consistency, inevitably leading to primitives that span across multiple semantic parts. Such inconsistency can cause undesirable artifacts in downstream tasks such as part-level shape editing or manipulation. In this paper, we introduce a new task - semantic-aware shape abstraction, where the goal is to produce abstractions that are both geometrically faithful and semantically consistent, ensuring that each primitive adheres strictly to a single semantic part without crossing semantic boundaries. We propose SemEllipsoid, a novel method to address this problem using ellipsoidal primitives. The core idea is to inject semantic constraints into the primitive optimization process leveraging the availability of semantic cues from large-scale foundation models. We design a fully differentiable projection-blending-evaluation scheme to measure semantic divergence against input semantic masks, and formulate an alternating optimization strategy to iteratively solve for optimal semantic assignment and primitive configurations. Our method is non-learning-based, requiring no data collection or network training, and generalizes well to shapes from arbitrary categories. It also supports different levels of abstraction according to user demand. Extensive experiments and evaluations validate the effectiveness of our approach across several 3D shape collections.

[CV-1] RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory

Abstract:Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot’s rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy’s training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.

作者: Assaf Singer,Maroun Khriesh,Noam Rotstein,Yoni Kasten,Or Litany

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Dense 3D tracking from monocular video requires establishing point correspondences over time, estimating their depth, and inferring their trajectories during occlusion. Existing methods typically learn these tasks jointly, a demanding objective given the scarcity of 4D supervision. We show that strong pretrained 2D trackers and 3D geometry models provide an effective foundation: lifted trajectories, with occluded segments simply interpolated, already rival dedicated 3D trackers using the same geometry. However, lifted trajectories inherit correspondence and depth errors, and under occlusion, their depth comes from the occluder rather than the tracked point. On WorldTrack, ReLift achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy, improving on the strongest baselines by 2.1 APD on all points and 3.0 on dynamic points, with faster configurations remaining competitive with leading 3D trackers while running faster than 4RC. Abstract:Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student using the difference between a teacher’s score and an online critic’s estimate of the student distribution’s score. We investigate what the critic needs, in capacity and in information, to provide a reliable training signal. Scaling the critic alongside the teacher, a strategy we call joint scaling, prevents collapse in our experiments and allows the student to benefit from larger teachers. On the information side, rather than forcing the critic to model a step-agnostic mixture of student outputs, we introduce a step-aware critic (STAC) that conditions on the student’s generation step to estimate step-specific scores. Together, joint scaling and STAC consistently improve few-step distillation across class-conditional ImageNet generation, text-to-image generation with SDXL and FLUX.2, and text-to-video generation with Wan2.1.

Abstract:Self-supervised learning relies on asymmetry between what a model observes and what it must explain. Recent methods learn 3D geometry from unposed images by predicting cameras and scene structure, then rendering held-out views. To avoid trivial solutions, they impose this asymmetry in the input space, restricting how views interact through separate branches or masked attention. We revisit this design with geometric accuracy, rather than rendering quality, as the main objective. When a held-out view lies between context views, the context already constrains the geometry it observes. We therefore impose the asymmetry in the 3D representation space, excluding held-out views only from the reconstructed scene while a shared backbone uses all views for correspondence. This improves depth and pose estimation over input-space designs. We further exploit view density: sparse and dense observations depict the same scene but provide different amounts of correspondence. Aligning sparse-context features with dense-context features supplies a geometric training signal alongside rendering, without a pretrained geometric teacher. We additionally align features with a frozen vision foundation model, which brings further gains. None of these signals requires geometric annotation, and the resulting model improves geometry estimation over prior self-supervised methods. Controlled experiments isolate the contribution of each component, and self-supervised pretraining also improves subsequent supervised training.

Abstract:Foundation models are becoming remarkably reliable at high-level reasoning, yet they remain too slow and costly to serve as fine-grained controllers. Conversely, fast policies like VLAs and whole-body controllers offer more efficient reflexes, but struggle to generalize. While pairing a deliberative brain (foundation models) with a reactive cerebellum (fast policies) seems natural for embodied systems, two obstacles remain: methods are built and scored on incompatible stacks, and their asynchronous coordination is difficult. 作者: Fabian Kruse,Lorenzo Baldassari,Ivan Dokmanić
